## Obtaining Abominable Asiago

### Crafting

Abominable Asiago can be crafted using the proper ingredients.

#### Abominable Asiago - 3 Piece Recipe

Hunters must reach the rank of Journeyman/Journeywoman before they can use this recipe.

| Formula: Abominable Asiago (3 pieces) |  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Recipe can be unlocked by: | Capture ONE of the following:MountainSlope SwimmerCraggy Ore |  |  |
| Item | ItemQty | ItemCost | Item Source |
| Faceted Sugar | 3 | N/A | Mountain and Slope Swimmer mice in Mountain |
| Iced Curd | 3 | N/A | Craggy Ore and Mountain mice in Mountain |
| Total | 0 gold | Cost Per Piece: 0 gold |  |
| Recipe costs represent Shoppe prices only. The cost of items obtained through other sources will affect the total cost of crafting. |  |  |  |

#### Abominable Asiago - 5 Piece Recipe

Hunters must reach the rank of Journeyman/Journeywoman before they can use this recipe.

| Formula: Abominable Asiago (5 pieces) |  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Recipe can be unlocked by: | Capture ONE of the following:MountainSlope SwimmerCraggy Ore |  |  |
| Item | ItemQty | ItemCost | Item Source |
| Faceted Sugar | 3 | N/A | Mountain and Slope Swimmer mice in Mountain |
| Iced Curd | 3 | N/A | Craggy Ore and Mountain mice in Mountain |
| Magic Essence | 1 | N/A | Tome Sprite Mouse in Crystal Library<br>Bruticus, the Blazing, Kalor'ignis of the Geyser and Stormsurge, the Vile Tempest in Queso Geyser<br>Ful'Mina, The Mountain Queen in Moussu Picchu<br>Granny Spice Mouse, Inferna, The Engulfed, Spice Finder Mouse and Spice Reaper Mouse‎ in Prickly Plains<br>Dream Drifter Mouse in Gnawnia Rift<br>Absolute Acolyte in Bristle Woods Rift<br>Shade of the Eclipse and The Total Eclipse in Valour Rift<br>Mysterious Box<br>Ful'Mina's Gift<br>Queso Canyon Grand Tour Treasure Chest<br>Use the Hunter's Hammer to smash:<br>Empowered SUPER&#124;brie+<br>Magical Rancid Radioactive Blue Cheese<br>Magical String Cheese<br>Maki Cheese<br>Maki String Cheese<br>SUPER&#124;brie+<br>Loot when opened:<br>Dark Chest<br>Scarab Chest<br>Shattered Chest<br>Unstable Broom<br>Unstable Ember Gadget<br>Loot when used:<br>Black Widow Base |
| Total | 0 gold | Cost Per Piece: 0 gold |  |
| Recipe costs represent Shoppe prices only. The cost of items obtained through other sources will affect the total cost of crafting. |  |  |  |

## Using Abominable Asiago Cheese

Abominable Asiago is required to attract Abominable Snow Mouse in the Mountain. Only Abominable Snow Mouse is attracted to Abominable Asiago.

## Related Items

### Staling Effect

- Stale Cheese - Produced by Abominable Asiago when it fails to attract a mouse and goes stale.

| This soft, creamy cheese has a mild flavour with strong undertones of fictional circumstances that are remarkably familiar and relatable. Mice who eat this tend to question why they started down their nefarious path in the first place. |  |

## Obtaining Allegory Anari Cheese

### Cheese Shoppe

Allegory Anari Cheese can be purchased from Afterword Acres Cheese Shoppe and Epilogue Falls Cheese Shoppe:

- 1 piece for:
8,000 gold
2 Allegory Algae
- 2 pieces for:
1 Magic Essence
2 Allegory Algae

## Using Allegory Anari Cheese

### Mice

Allegory Anari Cheese is required to attract the following mice:

- Afterword Acres
Deciduous Destroyers mice
Maniacal Maple
Brash Birch
Wailing Willow

- Epilogue Falls
Agile Algae Eaters mice
Loutish Loach
Pesky Pleco
Shifty Shrimp

## Hunter's Hammer

Smashing Allegory Anari Cheese with the Hunter's Hammer yields 1 Allegory Algae.

## Using Checkmate Cheese

### Locations

- Zugzwang's Tower - using Checkmate Cheese improves the chance a Hunter will encounter the mice needed to fill empty silhouettes in the HUD. For example, if a Hunter needs to attract a Mystic Rook to unlock access to the Mystic Queen, arming Checkmate Cheese will increase the chances of encountering the Mystic Rook.

### Mice

- Checkmate Cheese will attract all the mice in Zugzwang's Tower, but is required to attract the Chess Master after either the Mystic King or Technic King is captured.

When doing a double run, the mice attraction pool changes when Checkmate Cheese is armed.

- Upon capturing the first King (either with Checkmate Cheese or with any Standard Cheese with Stalemate Charm):
If Checkmate Cheese is armed, the mice pool will include the Chess Master, the Rook of the first side done, and whichever mice have been unlocked from the second side.
If Standard Cheese is armed, the mice pool will include the Pawn of the first side done, and whichever mice have been unlocked from the second side.

### Staling Effect

- Stale Cheese - Produced by Checkmate Cheese when it fails to attract a mouse and goes stale.

## Usage

### Location

- Fungal Cavern
Glowing Gruyere Cheese is required to attract the Gruyere Grazer mouse sub-group.
- Labyrinth and Zokor
Glowing Gruyere Cheese can attract all Citizens of Zokor with the exception below.
Glowing Gruyere Cheese removes Shadow Stalker from attraction pool.
- Moussu Picchu
Glowing Gruyere Cheese can attract all Potion Brewer.
Glowing Gruyere Cheese is required to attract Homeopathic Apothecary.

### Potion

- Epic Cheese Potion: converts Glowing Gruyere Cheese to Dragonvine Cheese
- Rainy Potion: converts Glowing Gruyere Cheese to Rainy Cheese
- Windy Potion: converts Glowing Gruyere Cheese to Windy Cheese

A complete list of Fungal Cavern Cheese can be found here.

- Stale Cheese - Produced by Glowing Gruyere Cheese when it fails to attract a mouse and goes stale.

Lactrodectus Lancashire Cheese is required to attract the Monstrous Black Widow Mouse in the Whisker Woods Rift. All three Rage levels must be over 25 for the Monstrous Black Widow Mouse to be available. The closer to 50 the Rage levels get, the more likely it is that Hunters will encounter the Monstrous Black Widow Mouse.

Lactrodectus Lancashire Cheese will attract other Whisker Woods Rift mice. When all three Rage levels are at 50, the Monstrous Black Widow Mouse is the only mouse attracted.

Unfortunately, the cost of launching the probes paired with their ability to only harvest a small quantity at a time means collecting this cheese is extremely expensive. Researching this cheese has proved quite dangerous during experiments in the Mousoleum as scientists seem to frequently become victims of Lycan attacks.<br>In October of 2016, the Sandmouse built a gigantic, spooky sandcastle near the Town of Gnawnia which lit up the night with glowing glyphs of the moon and stars. After he was defeated, we thought we were safe, but the Sandmouse might have had other plans in mind...<br>In our dreams, the Sandmouse brought visions of the moon crashing down onto Gnawnia. Digby scientists dismissed this as mere illusion, confirming that the moon was still at the same distance as it had ever been.<br>Then suddenly, an enormous meteor erupted across our sky and slammed into the desert sands south of the Gnawnian Express Station! Was this a mere coincidence or the Sandmouse's doing? Either way, the supply of Meteorite Pieces greatly increased as a result!<br>Use this lunar cheese at Fort Rox for perfect attraction of mice and to encounter more mice that drop better loot! |  |

## Using Rancid Radioactive Blue Cheese

Rancid Radioactive Blue Cheese attracts all mice in the Toxic Spill.

Rancid Radioactive Blue Cheese can attract mice in Laboratory, Mousoleum, Catacombs, Forbidden Grove and Acolyte Realm that are also attracted to Radioactive Blue Cheese in the respective locations.

## Related Items

### Cheese

- Radioactive Blue Cheese - can be converted to Rancid Radioactive Blue Cheese using potions
- Magical Rancid Radioactive Blue Cheese - can be used to attract more varieties of mice as compared to Rancid Radioactive Blue Cheese

### Potions

The following potions can be used to create Rancid Radioactive Blue Cheese:

- Rancid Radioactive Blue Potion

### Crafting Items

The following items are required for crafting Rancid Radioactive Blue Cheese:

- Radioactive Curd
- Radioactive Sludge

### Staling Effect

- Radioactive Sludge - Produced by Rancid Radioactive Blue Cheese when it fails to attract a mouse and goes stale.

## Using Vanilla Stilton Cheese

### Balack's Cove

Vanilla Stilton Cheese will attract all the mice in Balack's Cove except Balack the Banished. It attracts the Derr Lich, Elub Lich, and Nerg Lich which drop the loot necessary for crafting Vengeful Vanilla Stilton Cheese. Vengeful Vanilla Stilton Cheese is required for attracting Balack the Banished.

### Jungle of Dread

If Hunters are washed out of Balack's Cove into the Jungle of Dread while hunting with Vanilla Stilton Cheese, their cheese will attract the Swarm of Pygmy Mice and, rarely, the Pygmy Wrangler Mouse.

- Vanilla Bean

- Stale Cheese - Produced by Vanilla Stilton Cheese when it fails to attract a mouse and goes stale.

## Obtained Via

The Artisan Charm can be bought at the Muridae Market Charm Shoppe for 1 Limestone Brick, 1 Coconut Timber, 1 Shard of Glass and 350 gold or at the King's Arms Charm Shoppe or King's Cart for 2 King's Credits. It cannot be refunded.

The Artisan Charm is also found in Purple Winter Hunt Gift Boxes and is sold at several Event Charm Shoppes.

# ✨ Charm: Baitkeep Charm

> **Type**: Charms | **Category**: Charms | **Source**: [Baitkeep Charm](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Baitkeep_Charm)

| Baitkeep Charm |  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Category: Misc. |  |  |  |
| Charm Statistics | Charm Info |  |  |
| Power: | 0 | Cost: | 0 |
| Power Bonus: | 0% | Limited Edition: | No |
| Attraction Bonus: | 0% | Crafted: | No |
| Luck: | 0 | Smashable: | No |
| Cheese Effect: | No Effect | Tradeable: | No |
| Consumed Upon: | Encounter, Stale | Giveable: | No |
| Larry's Loot Lexicon: | MouseHunt Info Page | Image: | External Link |
| This charm is imbued with a particularly useful spell that harnesses the resonant frequencies of environmental magic to preserve an equipped piece of cheese, preventing it from being taken from your trap! Every time a piece of cheese is preserved by a Baitkeep charm, the cheese will remain intact but the charm will be consumed.<br>However, there are some environments in Gnawnia where the resonant frequencies can be disrupted, causing a phenomenon known as Baitkeep Interference. In these environments there is a 50% chance of Baitkeep Interference occurring whenever the charm is used. When Baitkeep Interference occurs, the charm is prevented from using its magic causing the cheese to get consumed but the charm remains intact for another use!<br>Baitkeep Interference has been known to occur in the following environments:<br><br>Cerulean Skyport<br>Draconic Depths<br>Afterword Acres<br>Epilogue Falls<br>Conclusion Cliffs |  |  |  |

## Obtained Via

The Baitkeep Charm can be obtained from:

- Mouse loot:
Ful'Mina, The Mountain Queen in Moussu Picchu
Retired Minotaur in Zokor
Various mice in Draconic Depths
- Purchasing from Charm Shoppe in Queso Canyon
- Convertibles:
Crate of Baitkeep Charms
Ful'Mina's Gift
Royal Loot Crate
Unstable Broom
Treasure Chests:
Chrome Slayer Treasure Chests
Golden Jade Treasure Chests
Lightning Treasure Chests
Relic Hunter Treasure Chests (Season 3 onward)
Slayer Treasure Chests

It can also be obtained as a result from hunting with an Unstable Charm, Gift Wrapped Charm or hunting in the Queso Canyon region with Queso Cannonstorm Base.

## Special Effects

The Baitkeep Charm makes the hunt consume itself instead of the Cheese armed.

### Baitkeep Interference

Baitkeep Interference in certain locations prevent the Baitkeep Charm from getting consumed, resulting in the Cheese being consumed instead of the Baitkeep Charm armed.

Baitkeep Interference occurs in the following locations:

- Draconic Depths
- Afterword Acres
- Epilogue Falls
- Conclusion Cliffs

### Charms

The Eggscavator Charge Charm was used to charge the Eggscavator during the annual Spring Egg Hunt event between Spring Egg Hunt 2013 and Spring Egg Hunt 2020.

- Each successful hunt with an Eggscavator Charge Charm armed raised the charge by 1, up to a maximum of 20.
- Each subsequent catch without an Eggscavator Charge Charm armed droped the charge by 1.
- While the Eggscavator was charging, the hunter had a chance of obtaining one of three different Charge Eggs, according to the current charge available on the Eggscavator.

- When the Eggscavator charge dropped to 0, the following message would appear in the Hunter's Journal:

# ✨ Charm: Fiery Warpath Charms

> **Type**: Charms | **Category**: Charms | **Source**: [Fiery Warpath Charms](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Fiery_Warpath_Charms)

These charms are used in the Fiery Warpath against The Marching Flame mice.

## Archer Charms

These charms increase the chance of encountering the Desert Archer Mouse in Wave 1, the Flame Archer Mouse in Wave 2, and the Crimson Ranger Mouse in Wave 3.

- Warpath Archer Charm
- Super Warpath Archer Charm - Also provides a 50% power bonus when a mouse of the Archer type is encountered.

## Cavalry Charms

These charms increase the chance of encountering the Sand Cavalry Mouse in Wave 2 and the Sandwing Cavalry Mouse in Wave 3. 
Arming these charms in Wave 1 will reduce the chance of encountering a Caravan Guard Mouse and won't be consumed.

- Warpath Cavalry Charm
- Super Warpath Cavalry Charm - Also provides a power bonus when a mouse of the Cavalry type is encountered.

## Commander Charms

These charms increase the chance of encountering the Crimson Commander Mouse in Waves 1-3.

- Warpath Commander's Charm
- Super Warpath Commander's Charm - Also provides a power bonus against the Crimson Commander Mouse. Disarms after each hunt.

## Gargantuamouse Charms

- Gargantua Charm - Arming this charm after reaching a streak of 7 will reduce the mouse population to just the Gargantuamouse. It is still possible to fail to attract or fail to catch the Gargantuamouse while this charm is armed.

## Mage Charms

These charms increase the chance of encountering the Inferno Mage Mouse in Wave 2 and the Magmarage Mouse in Wave 3. 
Arming these charms in Wave 1 will reduce the chance of encountering a Caravan Guard Mouse and won't be consumed.

- Warpath Mage Charm
- Super Warpath Mage Charm - Also provides a power bonus when a mouse of the Mage type is encountered.

## Scout Charms

These charms increase the chance of encountering the Vanguard Mouse in Wave 1, the Sentinel Mouse in Wave 2, and the Crimson Watch Mouse in Wave 3.

- Warpath Scout Charm
- Super Warpath Scout Charm - Also provides a 50% power bonus when a mouse of the Scout type is encountered.

## Warmonger Charms

These charms increase the variety of charms and quantity of orbs that are dropped by the Warmonger Mouse. They also improve the chance that the Warmonger Mouse will drop an Oasis Bead, Sandblasted Metal, or Sphynx Crystal as loot.

- Monger Charm

## Warrior Charms

These charms increase the chance of encountering the Desert Soldier Mouse in Wave 1, the Flame Warrior Mouse in Wave 2, and the Crimson Titan Mouse in Wave 3.

- Warpath Warrior Charm
- Super Warpath Warrior Charm - Also provides a 50% power bonus when a mouse of the Warrior type is encountered.

## Miscellaneous Charms

These charms provide a 150% power bonus against The Marching Flame mice.

- Flamebane Charm

## Obtained Via

# 🧪 Potion: Potion

> **Type**: Potions | **Category**: Potions | **Source**: [Potion](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Potion)

## Overview

Potions are used to convert one or more types of item into a different type. Hunters can find their Potions in their inventory.
Potions are used by Hunters to acquire various Cheeses that are occasionally necessary for attracting specific mice in specific locations. The same is true for Charms.
Certain Potions may also provide various options of conversion that affects the input cost amount and total amount of cheese converted.

## Conversion Strategy

Hunters should be aware that some cheeses that can be created using Potions, may also be obtained in other ways that may require more or less gold.
Hunters should also take into consideration their Hunter's Title when using Potions, as larger quantities of the created cheese can sometimes be obtained in an easier method when a Hunter increases in rank.

## Potion Categories

Potions are separated into various Potion Categories, usually based on where the item is primarily used in the Kingdom.
These categories are:

- Afterword Acres
- Basic Bait
- Bristle Woods
- Bristle Woods Rift
- Burroughs Rift
- Draconic Depths
- Epilogue Falls
- Gloomy Greenwood
- Gnawnia Rift
- King's Gauntlet
- Laboratory
- Moussu Picchu
- Prologue Pond
- Special
- Sunken City
- Vintage Items
- Whisker Woods

Potions labeled under Vintage Items were earned and used in past Events that required the Hunter to convert certain Cheeses or Charms into event related items for event progression.
Current Events have no need for these Potions and thus were shelved. Hunters can still use these Potions and converted items while hunting.

# 📦 Special Item: Special

> **Type**: Special | **Category**: Special Items | **Source**: [Special](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Special)

Special Items are items that appear in the Special Inventory tab. In particular, interactive special items are also known as Convertibles. Each convertible includes two action buttons which will convert one or all of that Special item into other inventory pieces.

Some convertibles will result in multiple items (such as Dragon's Chest or Mysterious Box), but most are randomly converted to only one item out of the possibilities. Even when only one item is produced, there is often a random range in the quantity of that item (such as anywhere between one and five Peppers per Pepper Plant).

Some special items can only be obtained during Events. A few are marked Limited Edition, which means they cannot be obtained after the event ends. Others have a Larry's Loot Lexicon page, but are hidden from the Special Inventory tab, and are designed to be tracked only via a Heads-Up Display during the event. Some interactive items are automatically opened on purchase.

## Non-interactive Special Items

These items cannot be interacted with from the Special Inventory page. Any actions with the items are generally made through a Heads-Up Display. They may be hidden on the Special page during or after the event.

## Interactive Special Items

These items can be interacted with from the Special Inventory page.

Many interactive items that appear in the Special section of the Hunter's Inventory have been separated into their own pages and are not included in this table. They include:

- Gifts - Includes many event boxes, gifts, parcels, and other items.
- Eggs - Available during the Spring Egg Hunt.
- Pepper Plants - Source of Peppers for crafting Havarti Cheeses
- Pumpkin Treat Baskets - Sometimes available during the annual Halloween event.
- Ronza's Satchels - Loot from an early visit from Ronza.
- Scroll Cases and similar items - Source of Treasure Maps
- Tomes of Wisdom - Awarded to Hunters upon completion of a Library Assignment.
- Unstable items:
Unstable Broom
Unstable Celestial Timechest
Unstable Crystal
Unstable Curd
Unstable Gourd
Unstable Ember Gadget
Unstable Magnum Opus
Unstable Manuscript
Unstable Rift Core

# 📦 Special Item: Pumpkin Treat Basket

> **Type**: Special | **Category**: Special Items | **Source**: [Pumpkin Treat Basket](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Pumpkin_Treat_Basket)

There's sure to be a Halloween treat in this spooky basket!

Pumpkin Treat Baskets are available during the Halloween Trick AND Treat events.

In 2010 through 2013, the year that a basket was released, it was known merely as Pumpkin Treat Basket; the next year, all of a hunter's inventory of the prior year is renamed to add the year in front. In this way, the loot from various years is distinct, even if a hunter waits more than a year to open the basket. In 2014, the basket was released with the year already in the name.

Pumpkin Treat Baskets can be sent as a gift to friends via gifting or transferred via the Give To Friends option. They appear on the Special inventory tab and may contain one of the following items:

# 📦 Special Item: Gift Baskets

Gift Baskets are items that a player can get by donating various amounts of money to the development of the game. They are added to the special section of the donator's inventory and can be sent to their friends. In addition to the items in the basket, they provide the user (the person who opens the basket) with a Lucky Golden Shield for 1, 2 or 4 months.

| A list of the nicest mice this winter that have warmed at least one other heart this season. Tracking down all the mice on the list shouldn't be too tough. Make sure you give each one a special pat on the back! |  |

## Acquiring the map

Sealed Nice List can be purchased from Great Winter Hunt event Cartographer.

The Hunter can find Nice List upon opening the scroll case.

Hunters rank Recruit and above can join the map.

## Redeeming the map

These maps can be cashed out if they have been started but remain uncompleted at the end of the event.

The rewards for incomplete maps can only be obtained after the event ends. The Map Captain may activate Consolation Mode, allowing each participant to claim a consolation reward. The rewards include gold, points, and Ancient Charms based on how complete the map is when redeemed. If the map has been dusted, the Rare Map Dust will not be returned to the Hunter that dusted the map, even if that Hunter is no longer on the map, but the consolation items rewarded will be increased.

## Mice

### 2023

During Great Winter Hunt 2023, each map contain 12 mice found in Great Winter Taiga.

### 2022

During Great Winter Hunt 2022, each map contain 15 mice found in Great Winter Taiga.

## Treasure Chests

These chests are awarded for completing a Nice List. The chests are dated with the year in which they are awarded.

2022 Nice Treasure Chests are awarded to Hunters who have completed a Nice List.

- 2018: Sealed Birthday Scroll Cases are obtained in Cartographer in The Grand Time Tampering during MouseHunt's Tenth Birthday.
- 2017: Sealed Birthday Scroll Cases are obtained by completing Year Five Orders in the Birthday Party Zone (2017) during MouseHunt's Ninth Birthday.
- 2016: Sealed Birthday Scroll Cases are obtained by completing Year Five Orders in the Birthday Party Zone (2016) during MouseHunt's Eighth Birthday.

Hunters are limited to two Sealed Birthday Scroll Cases in their inventory at a time.

## Redeeming the map

These maps can be cashed out if they have been started but remain uncompleted at the end of the event.

The rewards for incomplete maps can only be obtained after the event ends. The Map Captain may activate Consolation Mode, allowing each participant to claim a consolation reward. The rewards include gold, points, and Ancient Charms based on how complete the map is when redeemed. If the map has been dusted, the Rare Map Dust will not be returned to the Hunter that dusted the map, even if that Hunter is no longer on the map, but the consolation items rewarded will be increased.

## Mice

These maps contain 20 mice found at the annual MouseHunt Birthday event location.

## Acquiring a Gilded Treasure Map

Hunters ranked Novice and above can find Gilded Treasure Maps in Gilded Scroll Cases purchased through Donation or the Marketplace.

Hunters may upgrade their Gilded Treasure Map to a Rare Gilded Treasure Map by using Rare Map Dust. This will double the guaranteed rewards, and increase the quantity of variable items received.

## Mice found on a Gilded Treasure Map

Each Gilded Treasure Map requires Hunters to capture 20 mice from around the Kingdom.

The mice found on these maps are tied to the Rank of the Hunter that opens the Gilded Scroll Case. All mice will be easy to encounter, based on that Hunter's rank. Maps opened by higher ranked Hunters will have a minimum rank to join.

## Gilded Treasure Chests

### Gilded Treasure Chests

These chests are rewarded upon completing Gilded Treasure Map after 6 November 2019.

#### Guaranteed Items

These items are found in each Gilded Treasure Chest.
Rare treasure chests are awarded to Hunters who have used Rare Map Dust on a Gilded Treasure Map.

Opening one of these treasure chests will reward the hunter with 1 month of the Lucky Golden Shield.

| Item | Common ChestAmount | Rare ChestAmount |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Gold | 50,000 | 100,000 |
| Points | 50,000 | 100,000 |
| Ancient Charm | 100 | 200 |
| Gilded Charm | 25 | 50 |
| Gilded Coin | 10 | 20 |

#### Variable Items

Hunters will receive a number of items from the following list.
While it is random which charms the hunter will receive,the hunter will receive an amount of 2 of the 6 charms available in the following list.
When opened, the chest will contain:
1) an amount of one of the following: Super Ancient Charms, Extreme Ancient Charms or Ultimate Ancient Charms
2) an amount of one of the following: Ultimate Luck Charms, Ultimate Lucky Power Charms or Ultimate Power Charms

# 📦 Special Item: Codex

> **Type**: Special | **Category**: Special Items | **Source**: [Codex](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Codex)

## Overview

Codex is the type of Special items that provide stat boosts and special effects to the Hunter's hunting. It includes but is not limited to:

- Power, Power Bonus, and Luck bonus
- The addition of certain mouse loot in certain conditions
- The effect boost for a set bonus

These items just need to be in the Hunter's inventory to have effect.

Gilded Birthday Scroll Case can be acquired from Premium Shop during MouseHunt Birthday event.

Hunters can find Gilded Birthday Event Map upon opening the scroll case.
Hunters of any rank can be invited to join the map.

## Mice

Each Gilded Birthday Event Map requires Hunters to catch 20 mice available during the annual MouseHunt Birthday event.

## Acquiring the map

Slayer Scroll Case can be obtained from:

- Relic Hunter Treasure Chests
- Gilded Treasure Chests
- Gilded Birthday Treasure Chests

Hunters ranked Archduke/Archduchess and above can find an Elite Slayer Treasure Map upon opening the scroll case.

Hunters ranked Knight and above can be invited to join an Elite Slayer Treasure Map.

## Mice

Each Elite Slayer Treasure Map requires Hunters to capture 40 mice from around the Kingdom.

## Treasure Chests

Elite Slayer Treasure Chests are awarded upon finishing Elite Slayer Treasure Maps after the start of Relic Hunter Season 9.
Rare treasure chests are awarded to Hunters who have used Rare Map Dust on an Elite Slayer Treasure Map.

These chests grants the Hunter Slayer Aura when opened.

## Advent Chocolate

- 2021: In addition to each day of the Advent Calendar, Advent Chocolate could also be obtained as a reward for completing Nice List or Naughty List.
- 2016 – 2020: In addition to each day of the Advent Calendar, Advent Chocolate could also be obtained as a reward for completing Nice List, Naughty List and from Great Winter Hunt Tournaments.
- 2015: In addition to each day of the Advent Calendar, Advent Chocolate could also be obtained as a reward for completing Nice List and Naughty List, from GWH Tournaments, and from the Extreme Toboggan Challenge General Store.
- 2014: In addition to each day of the Advent Calendar, Advent Chocolate could also be obtained as Loot from various mice in the Festive Snow Fort, as an extra reward for placing well in an event Tournament, and as a reward for completing the Snow Fort.

# 📦 Special Item: Folklore Forest Inventory

> **Type**: Special | **Category**: Special Items | **Source**: [Folklore Forest Inventory](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Folklore_Forest_Inventory)

These are special items that are used to progress in Foreword Farm, Prologue Pond, Table of Contents, Bountiful Beanstalk, School of Sorcery, Draconic Depths, Afterword Acres, Epilogue Falls, and Conclusion Cliffs.
They can be accessed from the Heads-Up Display in those locations.

## Foreword Farm

### Papyrus Seed

These tough little seeds are a valuable resource for the farmers of the Foreword Farm as they are necessary for growing both Mythical Mulch and Parable Papyrus Plants in those fertile fields. Unfortunately for the farmers, these seeds are considered a tasty treat to the Seed Stower mice in the area so they have a tendency to hoard them!

### Mythical Mulch

This enchanted and entirely organic mixture is a byproduct harvested from Mythical Mulch Plants that have been grown in the fertile fields of the Foreword Farm. Unlike traditional mulches, this unique mixture has absorbed the profound mythical energy inherent in the soil of the Folklore Forest and is therefore a necessary ingredient for growing Parable Papyrus Plants.

### Parable Papyrus

This thick, coarse, paper-like material is harvested from the pith of Parable Papyrus Plants which only grows in the open fields of the Foreword Farm. Unlike traditional papyrus, these sheets are imbued with a unique metaphysical property which only allows them to absorb the bizarre but potent Inspiration Ink that comes from the curious aquatic creatures of the Prologue Pond.

This is one of the key ingredients for crafting the various Draft Derby cheeses in the Table of Contents.

This aged coin may be worn around the edges but its value is likely even higher now than when it was first minted. ## Prologue Pond

### Ingenuity Grub

These brightly-coloured insects are known for their gumption, hypnotic glow, and their uniquely inspirational flavour! They are a favourite of the Grub Gatherer mice who dig them up along the shores of the Prologue Pond. Unbeknownst to them however, these grubs can be made into a special type of cheese that is a very alluring bait when fishing in the shallower parts of the pond.

This is the main ingredient necessary for creating Grubbeen Cheese.

### Cleverness Clam

There is more than meets the eye to these shrewd shellfish. They can be found clinging to the aquatic mice in the shallower parts of the Prologue Pond and it is believed that the two have a symbiotic relationship. These clever creatures attach themselves to the Shallow Swimmer mice in order to avoid the deeper regions of the pond where the mice down there see them as more of a snack than a sidekick. Only the intoxicating scent of Brainstorm Chum is strong enough to cause the Shallow Swimmers to shake these clams loose.

This is the main ingredient necessary for creating Clamembert Cheese.

### Inspiration Ink

This illuminating substance is produced by the bizarre aquatic creatures that dwell in the deeper parts of the Prologue Pond. Only the intoxicating scent of Brainstorm Chum is strong enough to cause the Deep Divers to discard this curious concoction. It is so potent and influential that it can only be safely applied to the coarse, mystical pages of Parable Papyrus that are grown exclusively in the fields of the Foreword Farm.

The true origin of these sopping coppers is unknown but many believe that they were tossed into the Prologue Pond long ago in exchange for a wish. ### Gnawbel Prize for Literature

This is the most prestigious literary award in all of Gnawnia and it is the ultimate achievement for any artist who lives by the quill. It is awarded to authors who are capable of writing profound and lengthy books with relatable characters, an unforgettable story, and a powerful, moving message. These solid gold trophies are coveted by the ingenious but infamous Mythweaver who seeks to hoard them all as a way of legitimizing his sinister rewrites.

Earn these esteemed accolades by writing the longest books in the Table of Contents.

### Rainbow Nib

If the pen is mightier than the sword then the nib must be mightiest of all! This extremely powerful pen nib was forged by the Mythweaver himself using calcified rainbow dust. When affixed to a Golden Quill, it transforms it into a Rainbow Quill which is capable of writing more words than ever thought possible!

The only way to obtain these rare nibs is to loot them from the Mythweaver after the Silver and Golden Quill upgrades have been unlocked in the Table of Contents. The higher the Encyclopedia Volume when the Mythweaver is caught, the more likely he will be to drop one of these.

### Fabled Fertilizer

These mysterious glowing pellets are enchanted with an old and powerful magic that is believed to originate from a legendary age that has long since been forgotten. Use this Fabled Fertilizer in the Bountiful Beanstalk to grow vines that will take you into the various floors of the Castle in the Clouds.

## Acquiring a Toxic Spill Treasure Map (Archduke/Archduchess)

The Toxic Scroll Case can be purchased at the Toxic Spill Cartographer in exchange for 3 Ancient Relics.

Hunters ranked Archduke/Archduchess and above can find Toxic Spill Treasure Map (Archduke/Archduchess) in Toxic Scroll Cases. Hunters ranked Hero and above can be invited to join Toxic Spill Treasure Map (Archduke/Archduchess).

## Redeeming a Toxic Spill Treasure Map (Archduke/Archduchess)

These maps can be cashed out if they have been started but remain uncompleted at the end of the Archduke/Archduchess level of the Toxic Spill.

The map owner can redeem an incomplete map at the end of the Archduke/Archduchess level of the Toxic Spill. The consolation prize for the incomplete map is based on the number of mice that have been found when the map is redeemed. Only the Map Captain may choose to activate the Consolation Mode. Once Consolation Mode has been activated, no more invites may be sent or claimed and each player remaining on the map can choose to claim the consolation reward or attempt to complete the map for the reward chest.

## Mice found on a Toxic Spill Treasure Map (Archduke/Archduchess)

These maps contained 22 mice found in the more severe levels of the Toxic Spill.

| A Wanted Poster for a local gang, sealed with the Marshall's wax. Hunt down the crew and their leader for a Bounty Reward!<br>With this in my inventory, the Bounty Hunter Mouse will avoid my trap, as I can only hunt down one of the Wild Bunch gang at a time. |  |

## Overview

Wanted Poster is a special type of Treasure Map, but with some differences:

- Some map mice in Claw Shot City are only available when the Hunter is working on a specific Wanted Poster.
- The Hunter have to clear the first 4 mice (also called the Accomplices) of the map to be able to attract the final mouse (also called the Ringleader).

## Acquiring a Wanted Poster

Bounty Hunter in Claw Shot City can drop Sealed Wanted Poster.

- The mouse are guaranteed to drop 2 Sealed Wanted Poster if Sheriff's Badge Charm is armed.
- Sealed Wanted Poster has a limit of 6.

The Hunter will find one of the 6 types of Wanted Poster upon opening a Sealed Wanted Poster.

- If the Hunter has not complete the Track Claw Shot City's Most Wanted adventure, the sealed poster will give a wanted poster that the Hunter hasn't completed yet.

Another Hunter rank Lord/Lady or above can be invited to join the Wanted Poster.

## Mice

Each Wanted Poster contains 4 Accomplices and 1 Ringleader.
All Accomplices need to be cleared for the Ringleader to be available.

Hunters ranked Grand Duke/Grand Duchess and above may purchase a Bristle Woods Rift Scroll Case from the Bristle Woods Rift Cartographer in exchange for 5 Ancient Relics. Hunters ranked Grand Duke/Grand Duchess and above can be invited to join Bristle Woods Rift Treasure Maps.

## Mice Found on a Bristle Woods Rift Treasure Map

Each Bristle Woods Rift Treasure Map contains 15 mice found in the Bristle Woods Rift.

## Acquiring a Colossal Rainbow Treasure Map

The Rainbow Scroll Case is awarded to Hunters during the King's Giveaway when opening a Mystery Prize Pack.

Colossal Rainbow Treasure Maps are only found when Hunters ranked Viceroy and above open a Rainbow Scroll Case.

## Redeeming a Colossal Rainbow Treasure Map

These maps can be cashed out at any point, provided at least one mouse has been captured.

The consolation prize for the incomplete map is based on the number of mice that have been found when the map is redeemed. Only the Map Captain may choose to activate Consolation Mode. Once Consolation Mode is active invites cannot be sent or claimed and the remaining Hunters will be able to claim the consolation prize or continue to try completing the map to receive the reward chest.

## Mice found on a Colossal Rainbow Treasure Map

These maps contain 150 mice found in areas of the Kingdom accessible to players ranked Viceroy and lower.

# 📦 Special Item: Compass Magnet

> **Type**: Special | **Category**: Special Items | **Source**: [Compass Magnet](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Compass_Magnet)

A special magnet that is used to recalibrate a confused compass! Using this on your Labyrinth Compass will remove 3 of every type of clue found during a maze expedition.

The magnetic forces found within the shifting walls of the Labyrinth twist and mangle this magnet after its use, grinding into a pile of 20 Minerals.

## Obtained Via

Compass Magnets can be purchased at the Labyrinth General Store in exchange for 12,000 gold, 10 Scholar Scrolls, 10 Plate of Fealtys, and 10 Tech Power Cores.

Compass Magnets can also be purchased at the King's Cart for 20 King's Credit.

They are also sometimes found in Labyrinth Treasure Chests and Rare Labyrinth Treasure Chests.

## Using Compass Magnets

Using a Compass Magnet in the Labyrinth will remove 3 of each type of clue from a Hunter's Compass.

Hunters can view their stock of Compass Magnets on the HUD and from the Special tab of their inventory under Equipment.

Using a Compass Magnet provides the Hunter with 20 Minerals.

## Links

- Larry's Loot Lexicon entry
- Image

# 📦 Special Item: Compressed Jet Stream

> **Type**: Special | **Category**: Special Items | **Source**: [Compressed Jet Stream](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Compressed_Jet_Stream)

Careful study of meteorological patterns has resulted in the ability to focus, compress, and contain the powerful jet streams that blow through the Floating Islands!

Any hunter who pries open this exquisite crate had best be ready to take flight because doing so will instantly release a Jet Stream in the Floating Islands. The Jet Stream will dissipate one day after opening but during that time, airships will travel faster in the Low and High Altitude islands. In addition to the speed bonus, this temporary force of nature will shake loose additional Storm Cells from Wardens and Paragons!

Opening this crate will extend the Jet Stream Aura for 24 hours which causes the following effects:
• +1 Exploration Bonus at the Floating Islands
• Sky Wardens will drop +4 Storm Cells
• Sky Paragons will drop +8 Storm Cells

## Overview

Compressed Jet Stream is an item that grant Jet Stream Aura upon opening.

## Source

- Great Winter Hunt 2022: purchased from General Store in Cinnamon Hill, Golem Workshop, and Ice Fortress for:
3 Frost Globe
- Great Winter Hunt 2023:
Golem Rewards when sending Snow Golem to Floating Islands (hat slots and scarf slots)
- Great Winter Hunt 2024:
Golem Rewards when sending Snow Golem to Floating Islands (hat slots and scarf slots)

## Usage

Opening each Compressed Jet Stream grants Jet Stream Aura for 24 hours. Doing so generates a journal entry:

The Aura duration stacks, so the expiry time is extended 24 hours each time the Hunter opens an additional Compressed Jet Stream.

# 📦 Special Item: Cork Bark

> **Type**: Special | **Category**: Special Items | **Source**: [Cork Bark](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Cork_Bark)

Cork Bark is a lightweight, porous wood coveted by the mice of the Queso Geyser. It is grown and harvested from the large cork trees found in this area and some mice have been known to grow this material right under their fur. The mice of this area use it to shield themselves from the frequent queso showers, provide camouflage and a rudimentary armour.

Enough of this gathered together should be able to create a cork big enough to plug up the Queso Geyser, increasing its pressure and causing an eruption which will attract new airborne Draconic mice to the area.

## Source

- Burly Bruiser, Cork Defender, Corky, the Collector, Corkataur, Fuzzy Drake, Horned Cork Hoarder, Rambunctious Rain Rumbler in Queso Geyser
- It can be obtained from opening a Queso Canyon Grand Tour Treasure Chest.
- It can be bought from King's Cart and King's Arms General Store for 2 King's Credits.

Hunters ranked Count/Countess can find Toxic Spill Treasure Map (Count/Countess) in Toxic Scroll Cases. Hunters ranked Hero and above can be invited to join Toxic Spill Treasure Map (Count/Countess).

## Redeeming an Toxic Spill Treasure Map (Count/Countess)

These maps can be cashed out if they have been started but remain uncompleted at the end of the Count/Countess level of the Toxic Spill.

The map owner can redeem an incomplete map at the end of the Count/Countess level of the Toxic Spill. The consolation prize for the incomplete map is based on the number of mice that have been found when the map is redeemed. Only the Map Captain may choose to activate the Consolation Mode. Once Consolation Mode has been activated, no more invites may be sent or claimed and each player remaining on the map can choose to claim the consolation reward or attempt to complete the map for the reward chest.

# 📦 Special Item: Cupcakes

> **Type**: Special | **Category**: Special Items | **Source**: [Cupcakes](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Cupcakes)

Cupcakes are part of MouseHunt's Seventh Birthday, MouseHunt's Eighth Birthday, and MouseHunt's Ninth Birthday events. Hunters collect them to fulfill orders and earn rewards. Cupcakes are obtained via loot dropped by mice caught with Cupcake Colby and Extra Sweet Cupcake Colby cheeses.

There are 5 types of cupcakes currently:

- Red Birthday Cupcake
Always present in Year One - Five cupcake orders, and usually present in Year Six/Seven cupcake orders. Especially common in Year Three orders.
- Yellow Birthday Cupcake
Always present in Year One - Five cupcake orders, and usually present in Year Six/Seven cupcake orders. Especially common in Year Four orders.
- Blue Birthday Cupcake
Always present in Year One - Five cupcake orders, and usually present in Year Six/Seven cupcake orders. Especially common in Year Five orders.
- Green Birthday Cupcake
Chance of being present in Year Two - Five cupcake orders, and always present in Year Six, Seven, Eight, and Nine cupcake orders.
- Rainbow Birthday Cupcake
Never present in Year One - Five cupcake orders. There is always one in a Year Six order and always 2 in Year Seven, Eight, and Nine orders.

They could be used to buy Assortment of Cupcakes at the 2015, 2016, and 2017 MouseHunt Birthday event. They may be required to purchase other items in the Birthday event shoppes, as well.

These maps can be cashed out if they have been started but remain uncompleted at the end of the Duke/Duchess level of the Toxic Spill.

The map owner can redeem an incomplete map at the end of the Duke/Duchess level of the Toxic Spill. The consolation prize for the incomplete map is based on the number of mice that have been found when the map is redeemed. Only the Map Captain may choose to activate the Consolation Mode. Once Consolation Mode has been activated, no more invites may be sent or claimed and each player remaining on the map can choose to claim the consolation reward or attempt to complete the map for the reward chest.

## Mice found on an Toxic Spill Treasure Map (Duke/Duchess)

These maps contained 20 mice found in the medium severity levels of the Toxic Spill.

# 📦 Special Item: Egg

> **Type**: Special | **Category**: Special Items | **Source**: [Egg](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Egg)

## Overview

Eggs are special loot that can be obtained during the annual Spring Egg Hunt.

Eggs are separated into 6 groups:

- Spring Eggs -- Available from Spring Egg Hunt Event Mice. They can only be found once per year.
- Mice Eggs -- Mice across Gnawnia will drop these eggs! Some eggs may require special circumstances to attract.
- Environment Eggs -- These eggs are found in specific locations throughout the Kingdom.
- Charge Eggs (Retired) -- These eggs can be found when Hunters use charms to charge their meter. The greater the charge, the better the egg. As of Spring Egg Hunt 2021, these eggs have been retired.
- Interface Eggs -- These eggs are found without sounding the horn. They can only be found once.
- Unique Eggs -- These eggs can be found when certain unique criteria is met!

## Spring Eggs

Spring Eggs (also referred to as Basic Eggs) are available only once during each Spring Egg Hunt.
Gift Egg are also occasionally available through Gifting for the duration of the event.

## Unique Eggs

Unique Eggs are bonus eggs that drop when certain unique criteria are met during the annual Spring Egg Hunt. Hunters must possess an Eggscavator to obtain these eggs. Specific requirements for obtaining and charging an Eggscavator can be found on the current Spring Egg Hunt event page.

The Eggsweeper Egg shown in the Eggscavator is a generic egg covering all the types of eggs rewarded from the Eggsweeper game.

# 📦 Special Item: Eggstra Fondue

> **Type**: Special | **Category**: Special Items | **Source**: [Eggstra Fondue](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Eggstra_Fondue)

Embark upon a gustatory odyssey as you indulge in the pinnacle of chocolatier craftsmanship. Specially formulated using eggstra eggs as a primary ingredient, a celestial symphony of flavor and texture awaits within this divine chocolate fondue.

Any eggs placed into this decadent dip, with a texture that can only be explained as an ethereal fusion of silk and satin, will activate the eggstra ingredient, doubling it!

This elevated chocolate fondue will harden into Chocolatonium when spent, as well as forming additional pieces for each egg placed inside AND created!

While active, Eggstra fondue will:

• Add 1 x Chocolatonium per hunt
• Add 1 x Chocolatonium per egg dropped by non-event mice
• Duplicate any eggs dropped by non-event mice
• When paired with the Chocolate Bar Base, every once in a while it will TRIPLE the eggs dropped instead of double!.

"Eggstra Fondue is NOT safe for consumption and should be handled with protective equipment"

## Overview

Eggstra Fondue is a resource item that has special effects during the annual Spring Egg Hunt event.

## Source

- Lady Laura's Chocolate Shop
- Using Hunter's Hammer on Eggstra Charm and Eggstra Charge Charm
- Gift Baskets:
Eggscellent Gift Basket
Eggsweeper Starter Pack
Eggstravagant Supply Kit
- Premium Shop during Spring Egg Hunt

## Special Effects

- Doubles eggs loot from non-event mice
- Generates 1 Chocolatonium per hunt

- Generates 1 Chocolatonium for each egg dropped by non-event mice

- It is consumed per hunt.

## Related Items

### Bases

- Chocolate Bar Base - has a chance to boost the egg doubling effect to be egg tripling

### Charms

- Eggstra Charm - has the same egg doubling effect, before being replaced by Eggstra Fondue
- Eggstra Charge Charm - has the same egg doubling effect and Chocolatonium generating effect, before being replaced by Eggstra Fondue

## Acquiring an Elite Treasure Map

Hunters ranked Archduke/Archduchess and above can find Elite Maps in Relic Hunter Scroll Cases dropped by the Relic Hunter Mouse in exchange for 1 Ancient Relic. Hunters ranked Lord and above can be invited to join Elite Maps.

Hunters may upgrade their Elite Treasure Map to a Rare Elite Treasure Map by using Rare Map Dust. This doubles the guaranteed rewards and increases the chance of receiving rare rewards.

## Mice found on an Elite Treasure Map

Elite Maps require Hunters to capture 40 mice from around the Kingdom. Mice found in very low level areas generally do not appear on these maps.

# 📦 Special Item: Fabled Fertilizer

> **Type**: Special | **Category**: Special Items | **Source**: [Fabled Fertilizer](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Fabled_Fertilizer)

These mysterious glowing pellets are enchanted with an old and powerful magic that is believed to originate from a legendary age that has long since been forgotten. The fertile magic contained in this burlap sack is far too potent for any normal plant but sprinkle some onto the mighty Bountiful Beanstalk and it will grow new vines that reach up beyond the clouds!

Use this Fabled Fertilizer in the Bountiful Beanstalk to grow vines that will take you into the various floors of the Castle in the Clouds.

## Overview

Fabled Fertilizer is a resource item that plays a key role in Bountiful Beanstalk.

## Source

- Mouse loot in Bountiful Beanstalk
Vinneus Stalkhome drops 1
Dungeon Master drops 5
Malevolent Maestro drops 20
Mythical Giant King has a chance to drop 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, or 30

## Usage

- Planting vines in Bountiful Beanstalk
Short vine costs 1
Medium vine costs 12
Tall vine costs 100

The first few volumes in this series seem to lead towards the origin of the timeless classic: The Tale of the Bountiful Beanstalk!<br>Upon opening this book, you'll embark on a scavenger hunt for items that have never existed in Gnawnia before so you'll need to solve the riddles provided in order to find them. # 📦 Special Item: Champion Kits

> **Type**: Special | **Category**: Special Items | **Source**: [Champion Kits](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Champion_Kits)

Champion Kits are items purchasable with Tournament Tokens in the Tournament Hall General Store or they are given as special rewards during event tournaments. They are similar to the Gift Baskets, but do not provide a Lucky Golden Shield and are non-transferable. They are added to the special section of the hunter's inventory.

## List of Champion Kits

### Available from Tournament Hall General Store

#### Acolyte Champion Kit

This kit contains materials helpful in tracking down the elusive and powerful Acolyte Mouse!

Inside you'll find:

- 3 Runes
- 1 Runic Potion
- 12 Stale Cheese

#### Balack's Cove Champion Kit

# 📦 Special Item: Fog Warden Stone

> **Type**: Special | **Category**: Special Items | **Source**: [Fog Warden Stone](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Fog_Warden_Stone)

It is difficult to make out any fine details on this small but compelling stone because of a thick grey cloud that envelopes it and never seems to dissipate. The immense power emanating from this thing is quite intimidating and yet somehow it feels almost... incomplete. As though it may be only a piece of something much greater.

Ful'Mina and her Storm Dragons guard these stones very carefully. The locals believe that the only way to retrieve one is by carrying a fully functional Skyfarer's Oculus while hunting.

## Acquiring A Fog Warden Stone

Hunters must first craft a Skyfarer's Oculus by repairing a Damaged Oculus dropped by Ful'Mina, The Mountain Queen. Afterwhich, all Storm Dragons will have a chance of dropping a Fog Warden Stone, along with the Wind Warden Stone, Rain Warden Stone and Frost Warden Stone.

## Usage

- Purchase the Dirigible and Flight License at the Moussu Picchu Cartographer together with the Skyfarer's Oculus, Wind Warden Stone, Rain Warden Stone and Frost Warden Stone for 2,500,000 Gold.

# 📦 Special Item: Fool's Gold

> **Type**: Special | **Category**: Special Items | **Source**: [Fool's Gold](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Fool's_Gold)

This incredible nugget looks an awful lot like gold. Thankfully, however, it is not such a common place metal. In fact, this tiny nugget is extremely rare and is therefore very valuable. Scientifically known as Pyrite, it is referred to as "Fool's Gold" because more than once someone has traded in a handful of the stuff for a single wedge of cheese thinking it was mere regular gold.

There is no shortage of shop keepers around when Fool's Gold might accidentally trade hands and provide them with an early retirement.

## Source

In Claw Shot City:

- Loot obtained from Pyrite, Prospector, and Glitchpaw Mice
- A reward from completing a Wanted Poster

In Gnawnian Express Station:

- Loot obtained from the Stowaway Mouse
- A reward for protecting the train in Gnawnian Express Station.

In Fort Rox:

- Loot obtained from the Mining Materials Manager, Hypnotized Gunslinger, Night Shift Materials Manager, and Wealthy Werewarrior mice.

Also available in Red Winter Hunt Gift Boxes if opened after Great Winter Hunt 2014.

In Cantera Quarry:

- Loot obtained from Nachous, The Molten

## Usage

- Claw Shot City Trapsmith
- Claw Shot City General Store
- Claw Shot City Charm Shoppe
- Claw Shot City Cartographer
- Gnawnian Express Station Charm Shoppe

> **Type**: Special | **Category**: Special Items | **Source**: [Frost Warden Stone](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Frost_Warden_Stone)

The icy chill of this tiny stone can be felt at a great distance and it penetrates the bones in a terrifying way. It is colder than the highest peak of the Gnawnian Mountains and the lowest depths of the Rodentian Iceberg. Great and terrible things could be accomplished with a power of this magnitude. These maps can be cashed out at any point, provided at least one mouse has been captured.

# 📦 Special Item: Footlockers

> **Type**: Special | **Category**: Special Items | **Source**: [Footlockers](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Footlockers)

During Larry's Football Challenge event in June 2014, hunters could obtain several varieties of Footlockers. All mice during the event had a chance of dropping a Football Footlocker; hunting with Striker Charms armed doubled the drop of these lockers. Upon opening this locker, a hunter had a chance at getting a Gnawnian Football; it was also possible to collect up to five footballs a day by visiting friend's Profile pages.

Each football allowed the hunter one shot at the Football Challenge, for a chance at better footlockers. On this page, a hunter was greeted with a message:

along with the rules:

There was also a button at the bottom stating Play! Costs 1 Football. You have X. This button reappears with the text changing to Play again! after being stopped early in a sequence. The hunter is presented with a sequence of up to 9 regular mice and two Football Superstars, along with a progress meter of 14 positions. The normal mice presented three different choices of moves to attempt; at least one of these was guaranteed to succeed although guessing incorrectly could still randomly get past the mouse. The set of regular mice changed each day. If the hunter leaves the page, they return to the same place in the sequence where they left off. Once a hunter runs out of footballs, attempting to play results in a message "Out of footballs! Get footballs from friends or mice!"

After the first two mice, the hunter chooses either to Shoot at the Bronze Net (Cowardly mouse as the defender) for a chance at a Bronze Footlocker, or Challenge the Football Superstar. If going on, the hunter then faced three mice before a choice to shoot at the Silver Net (Stoutgear defender) for a Silver Footlocker, or face another Football Superstar. If the hunter went on, another four mice appeared before the hunter had to take a shot at the Gold Net (Hookshot defender) for a Gold Footlocker. At each net, a mouse defender was shown along with five possible angles to shoot; the hunter randomly either gets "Goal! - Congratulations! You received X Footlocker" for the win, or gets a message of either "SAVED - The goalie blocked your shot. Better luck next time!" or "Hit the Post - So close!" ending the run with no reward.

At each net, this message appears:

The Football Superstar has this message:

and only one possible action, Attempt to dribble past. A hunter gets a random result of either "got lucky!" to continue the run or "unlucky" to end the run.

The following is a list of mice encountered during at least one day, along with the possible moves against them, with a (*) by an action guaranteed to succeed. In a couple of cases, the mouse pictured did not match the mouse named.

Also during the Football Challenge, hunters had a choice to choose a particular country to root for during the FIFA World Cup games, from their Profile page. Each goal that the hunter scored counted for that country, and the page would show MouseHunt goals scored per country for the current day's matches.

By opening the metal footlockers, a hunter could obtain theme scraps required to craft the Football Journal Theme collectible, which allows using Larry's Football Challenge Theme on the Profile page. A hunter could own at most one of a given scrap.

## Acquiring an Toxic Spill Treasure Map (Grand Duke/Duchess)

The Toxic Scroll Case can be purchased at the Toxic Spill Cartographer in exchange for 3 Ancient Relics.

Hunters ranked Grand Duke/Grand Duchess can find Toxic Spill Treasure Map (Grand Duke/Duchess) in Toxic Scroll Cases. Hunters ranked Hero and above can be invited to join Toxic Spill Treasure Map (Grand Duke/Duchess).

## Redeeming an Toxic Spill Treasure Map (Grand Duke/Duchess)

These maps can be cashed out if they have been started but remain uncompleted at the end of the Grand Duke/Grand Duchess level of the Toxic Spill.

The map owner can redeem an incomplete map at the end of the Grand Duke/Grand Duchess level of the Toxic Spill. The consolation prize for the incomplete map is based on the number of mice that have been found when the map is redeemed. Only the Map Captain may choose to activate the Consolation Mode. Once Consolation Mode has been activated, no more invites may be sent or claimed and each player remaining on the map can choose to claim the consolation reward or attempt to complete the map for the reward chest.

## Mice found on an Toxic Spill Treasure Map (Grand Duke/Duchess)

These maps contained 21 mice found in the more severe levels of the Toxic Spill.

## Acquiring a Halloween Treasure Map

These maps were only available from Sealed Halloween Scroll Cases during the Halloween 2015 event.

The Sealed Halloween Scroll Case can be purchased at the Haunted Terrortories Cartographer in exchange for 1 Ancient Relic

Hunters are limited to two Sealed Halloween Scroll Cases in their inventory at a time.

## Redeeming a Halloween Treasure Map

These maps can be cashed out if they have been started but remain uncompleted at the end of the event.

The rewards for incomplete maps can only be obtained after the event ends. The Map Captain may activate Consolation Mode, allowing each participant to claim a consolation reward. The rewards include gold, points, and Ancient Charms based on how complete the map is when redeemed. If the map has been dusted, the Rare Map Dust will not be returned to the Hunter that dusted the map, even if that Hunter is no longer on the map, but the consolation items rewarded will be increased.

## Mice found on a Halloween Treasure Map

These maps contained 20 mice found in the Haunted Terrortories 2015.

## Acquiring a Hard Grand Ghostship Map

The Sealed Ghostship Scroll Case can be purchased at the Cartographer in exchange for 5 Ancient Relics.

Hunters ranked Baron and above will find Hard Grand Ghostship Maps in Sealed Ghostship Scroll Cases.

## Redeeming a Hard Grand Ghostship Map

These maps can be cashed out if they have been started but remain uncompleted at the end of the event.

The rewards for incomplete maps can only be obtained after the event ends. The Map Captain may activate Consolation Mode, allowing each participant to claim a consolation reward. The rewards include gold, points, Ghastly Galleon Gouda, Spooky Charms, Spooky Shuffle Ticket, and Cannonballs based on how complete the map is when redeemed. If the map has been dusted, the Rare Map Dust will not be returned to the Hunter that dusted the map, even if that Hunter is no longer on the map, but the consolation items rewarded will be increased.

## Mice found on an Hard Grand Ghostship Map

These maps contained 15 mice found in the Halloween locations and mice from lower ranked areas.

# 📦 Special Item: Ice Drill

> **Type**: Special | **Category**: Special Items | **Source**: [Ice Drill](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Ice_Drill)

Ice Drill is a specialized drill used to quickly bore through ice, assisting hunters in reaching deeper depths of the Iceberg. There are four types of ice drills available at either the Slushy Shoreline or Iceberg General Store, as shown in the table below. Each drill can skip 20 feet of the Iceberg per charge used. A hunter can own at most one of each type of drill at a time; earlier drills can be repurchased after an upgrade for hunters desiring a complete collection, but the bonus drill charges are only available on the first purchase.

| Type of Ice Drill | Cost | Max drillsper invasion | Comes with | More Info |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ice Drill Mk. I | 50,000 gold10 War Scraps | 5 | 3 Drill Charges | MouseHunt Info Page |
| Ice Drill Mk. II | 100,000 gold25 War ScrapsIce Drill Mk. I | 6 | 3 Drill Charges | MouseHunt Info Page |
| Ice Drill Mk. III | 150,000 gold50 War ScrapsIce Drill Mk. II | 7 | 4 Drill Charges | MouseHunt Info Page |
| Diamond Ice Drill | 300,000 gold100 War ScrapsIce Drill Mk. IIIDiamond Drill Bits | 8 | 5 Drill Charges | MouseHunt Info Page |

Drilling past Mouse Generals will skip them and their loot. Also, if an Ice Drill has already been used, then upgrading in the same Iceberg invasion will not cool it down. For example, using 7 Drill Charges with the Ice Drill Mk. III and then upgrading to the Diamond Ice Drill in the same run will allow you to use 1 extra drill on that invasion, not an additional 8.

Each use of a drill leaves the following message in the Hunter's Journal:

Hovering over the Drill button on the Heads Up Display (HUD) of the Iceberg normally shows this message:

After using the available charges for the strength of the drill, the message changes to:

# 📦 Special Item: Labyrinth Lantern

> **Type**: Special | **Category**: Special Items | **Source**: [Labyrinth Lantern](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Labyrinth_Lantern)

The Labyrinth Lantern illuminates the hallways, allowing a better observation of the surrounding area resulting in finding more clues.

Catching a clue-dropping mouse within the Labyrinth with the Lantern active will yield an additional bonus clue.

Requires Lantern Oil to use. When lit, the Labyrinth Lantern burns oil on every hunt.

## Acquiring a Labyrinth Lantern

The Labyrinth Lantern can be purchased at the Labyrinth General Store in exchange for 33,333 gold. It cannot be refunded. Hunters may only own 1 Labyrinth Lantern.

## Using a Labyrinth Lantern

The Labyrinth Lantern requires Lantern Oil to function.

The Labyrinth Lantern is armed from the HUD in the Labyrinth. When armed, mice in the Labyrinth will drop an additional clue.

The Labyrinth Lantern disarms automatically when Hunters enter Labyrinth Intersections.

## Related Items

- Lantern Oil - This item fuels the Labyrinth Lantern, allowing Labyrinth mice to drop additional clues. It can be purchased in the Labyrinth General Store.

# 📦 Special Item: Lantern Oil

> **Type**: Special | **Category**: Special Items | **Source**: [Lantern Oil](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Lantern_Oil)

A tiny crystal flask containing a viscous oil used to fuel the Labyrinth Lantern. When lit, the Labyrinth Lantern burns oil on every hunt.

## Acquiring Lantern Oil

Lantern Oil can be purchased at the Labyrinth General Store and Zokor General Store in exchange for 680 gold, 1 Scholar Scroll, 1 Plate of Fealty, and 1 Tech Power Core.

It can be found as loot from Reanimated Carver Mouse in the Labyrinth and Zokor and the Retired Minotaur Mouse in Zokor.

It is also sometimes found in Labyrinth Treasure Chests, Rare Labyrinth Treasure Chests, Orange Winter Hunt Boxes and Ful'Mina's Gifts

## Using Lantern Oil

Hunters must own a Labyrinth Lantern in order to use Lantern Oil. Lantern Oil fuels the Labyrinth Lantern.

Hunters can view their stock of Lantern Oil on the HUD and from the Special tab of their inventory under Equipment.

The Labyrinth Lantern is lighted from the HUD in the Labyrinth. When lit, mice in the Labyrinth will drop an additional clue.

The Labyrinth Lantern disarms automatically when Hunters enter Labyrinth Intersections so that Hunters do not waste Lantern Oil on mice that do not drop clues.

## Related Items

- Labyrinth Lantern - This item is required to use Lantern Oil. It can be purchased in the Labyrinth General Store.
- Lantern Oil Charm - This charm causes mice in the Labyrinth to drop an extra clue when one is found; its effect stacks with Lantern Oil.
- Super Lantern Oil Charm - This charm causes mice in the Labyrinth to drop two extra clues when one is found; its effect stacks with Lantern Oil.

# 📦 Special Item: Letter to Santa

> **Type**: Special | **Category**: Special Items | **Source**: [Letter to Santa](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Letter_to_Santa)

Several Letters to Santa play a major role in the Great Winter Hunt 2012 event. Each letter is dropped by the Confused Courier Mouse, to unlock various stages within the event, and tracks the various requests made by Greedy Al that led to his disillusionment with Santa and the creation of the MegaBuy Mart. The first letter (age 12) can be found in any Location, and unlocks travel to the MegaBuy Mart. All other letters can only be found by hunting with Festive Feta in the MegaBuy Mart, according to the following schedule:

| Letter | Available | Toy | New Mouse | Repeat Mouse |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Age 6 | 10 December | Moon Mobile | Triple Lutz | Scrooge |
| Age 7 | 12 December | Toy Raygun | Ribbon | Mouse of Winter Past |
| Age 8 | 14 December | Toy Robot | Snowglobe | Mouse of Winter Present |
| Age 9 | 17 December | Dragon Mouse Action Figure | Gingerbread | Mouse of Winter Future |
| Age 10 | 19 December | Ball and Cup | Ridiculous Sweater | Squeaker Claws |
| Age 11 | 21 December | Toasty Scarf | Snowblower | Mad Elf |

After a letter has been found, it unlocks a new mouse attracted to Festive Feta, as well as a mouse from prior events attracted to Winter Charms, both of which drop a toy part; collecting 10 of these parts then builds the toy. Constructing all 6 toys is necessary to purchase the Wrapped Gift Trap to catch Greedy Al and unlock the Last Letter.

While it is possible to view Larry's Loot Lexicon for each letter in advance, that only provides a link to the actual letter contents, and if a hunter has not yet obtained that letter, a popup box appears warning:

Likewise, viewing a toy prior to unlocking the letter sees merely this description:

Progress of letters received can be seen in the Heads-Up Display at the MegaBuy Mart.

## Letters to Santa

### Letter to Santa, Age 12

Oh no! This mouse clearly never received any of his Winter Hunt presents, and has grown bitter and vengeful!
We must warm his frosty heart by making all the toys he missed as a child.
Hunt until you find a Confused Courier with a misplaced letter, and then find the parts needed to build the missing Winter Hunt toy!

The image of this letter reads:

### Letter to Santa, Age 6

To build Moon Mobile, you'll need:
10 Moon Mobile Parts

The image of this letter reads:

### Letter to Santa, Age 7

To build Toy Raygun, you'll need:
10 Raygun Parts

The image of this letter reads:

### Letter to Santa, Age 8

To build Toy Robot, you'll need:
10 Robot Parts

The image of this letter reads:

### Letter to Santa, Age 9

To build Dragon Mouse Action Figure, you'll need:
10 Toy Dragon Parts

The image of this letter reads:

### Letter to Santa, Age 10

To build Ball and Cup, you'll need:
10 Ball and Cup Parts

The image of this letter reads:

### Letter to Santa, Age 11

To build Toasty Scarf, you'll need:
10 Scarf Parts

The image of this letter reads:

### Last Letter

You gave Greedy Al his presents!
He was so overjoyed at receiving all his childhood toys that he decided to remain behind and hand out presents to any mice who visit your trap!

The image of this letter reads:

## Toy Parts

The following toy parts are collected in response to each letter:

### Moon Mobile Parts

All little Albert wanted was the moon. Unfortunately, he couldn't have the moon for obvious reasons, and Moon Cheese is known to have pretty serious side-effects. This Moon Mobile is a safe and pretty alternative that's sure to cheer him up!
Collect 10 Moon Mobile Parts to build this toy!

### Raygun Parts

Since real laser guns don't actually exist (and if they did, they'd be a massive safety issue), hopefully this Toy Raygun will cheer Albert up and satisfy his long-repressed childhood desires.
Collect 10 Raygun Parts to build this toy!

### Robot Parts

Every kid wants a real robot. Well, most kids. Okay, some kids. Still, getting one is a tall order, especially since the only robots that exist are the kind that build cars in factories, and that's not usually what kids are looking for.
However, this Toy Robot should be more in line with what little Albert was looking for, and should bring a bright little smile to his face!
Collect 10 Robot Parts to build this toy!

### Toy Dragon Parts

Who's the coolest mouse?
"Dragon Mouse!"
Who's got real* Fire-Breath Action?
"Dragon Mouse!"
Who's the affordably-priced toy that all the kids want this year?
"Dragon Mouse!"
Kids, this year, ask your parents for...
"Dragon Mouse!"
Because you might not get anything else!
Collect 10 Toy Dragon Parts to build this toy!

### Ball and Cup Parts

The traditional ball and cup is known world-wide for providing several seconds worth of fun per child, per year. Little Albert never got his when he asked, and while he really wasn't missing out on much, hopefully it'll warm big Al's heart to get one, even all these years later.
Collect 10 Ball and Cup Parts to build this toy!

### Scarf Parts

When all is said and done, what you need comes above what you want. And staying warm in the cold chill of winter is extra-important. Without it, your tiny little heart could freeze, and that could have long-term repercussions. Why, you might forget about the magic of the season entirely, becoming a greedy and impulsive meanie, placing yourself above all other and...
Wait... Oh no! That poor little mouse. This explains everything!
Hopefully this Toasty Scarf can finally warm his heart and remind him why giving is better than getting this year.
Collect 10 Scarf Parts to build this toy!

## Acquiring a Living Garden Treasure Map

Hunters ranked Baron/Baroness and above can find Living Garden Treasure Maps in Living Garden Scroll Cases available for purchase at the Living Garden Cartographer in exchange for 6 Ancient Relics. Hunters ranked Baron/Baroness and above can be invited to join Living Garden Maps.

Hunters may upgrade their Living Garden Treasure Map to a Rare Living Garden Treasure Map by using Rare Map Dust. This doubles the guaranteed rewards and increases the chance of receiving rare rewards.

## Mice found on a Living Garden Treasure Map

Living Garden Treasure Maps require Hunters to capture 30 mice from the Living Garden, Twisted Garden, Lost City, Cursed City, Sand Dunes, and Sand Crypts.

## Living Garden Treasure Chests

With the beginning of Season 3 of Treasure Maps, Living Garden Treasure Chests begin rewarding a much smaller selection of items that are targeted at the Living Garden area. Contents of these chests will no longer change with the treasure hunting season.

The contents of Season 1 and Season 2 Living Garden Treasure Chests are dependent on the Season of treasure hunting and are labelled with the season in which they were awarded.

## Acquiring a Toxic Spill Treasure Map (Lord/Lady)

The Toxic Scroll Case can be purchased at the Toxic Spill Cartographer in exchange for 3 Ancient Relics.

Hunters ranked Lord/Lady to Baron/Baroness can find Toxic Spill Treasure Map (Lord/Lady) in Toxic Scroll Cases. Hunters ranked Hero and above can be invited to join Toxic Spill Treasure Map (Lord/Lady).

## Redeeming a Toxic Spill Treasure Map (Lord/Lady)

These maps can be cashed out if they have been started but remain uncompleted at the end of the Lord/Lady to Baron/Baroness level of the Toxic Spill.

The map owner can redeem an incomplete map at the end of the Lord/Lady to Baron/Baroness level of the Toxic Spill. The consolation prize for the incomplete map is based on the number of mice that have been found when the map is redeemed. Only the Map Captain may choose to activate the Consolation Mode. Once Consolation Mode has been activated, no more invites may be sent or claimed and each player remaining on the map can choose to claim the consolation reward or attempt to complete the map for the reward chest.

## Mice found on a Toxic Spill Treasure Map (Lord/Lady)

These maps contained 8 mice found in the less severe levels of the Toxic Spill.

# 📦 Special Item: Magical Holiday Scarf

> **Type**: Special | **Category**: Special Items | **Source**: [Magical Holiday Scarf](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Magical_Holiday_Scarf)

This cozy and luxurious scarf was meticulously hand-crafted by the Frost King himself from the finest frosty fabrics north of Gnawnia. Each woven fibre has been saturated with the very essence of the holiday season making this scarf into an enormously powerful amplifier for festive magic!

Dress your Snow Golem with this ultimate festive accessory and it will return from its journey with an extremely valuable reward!

## Overview

Magical Holiday Scarf is a resource item that plays a key role during the annual Great Winter Hunt.
It is set to expire after the end of each Great Winter Hunt.

## Source

- Great Winter Hunt 2022
Frost King drops 1 each catch
Advent Calendar has 1 as a bonus item on Day 24
Profile Gifting: 1 from Larry
- Great Winter Hunt 2023
Frost King drops 1 each catch
Reward Track (3 total)
Milestone 7 (35 golems): 1 Scarf
Milestone 9 (60 golems): 2 Scarves
Golem Gift Box has 3
Profile Gifting: 1 from Larry
Advent Calendar has 1 as a bonus item on Day 24

## Usage

Magical Holiday Scarf can be added to golem to get extra rewards:

- 2022 Golem Rewards
- 2023 Golem Rewards

## Related Items

### Hunter's Hammer

- Magical Holiday Scarf can be smashed to yield 1 Ultimate Snowball Charm.

# 📦 Special Item: Minotaur Key

> **Type**: Special | **Category**: Special Items | **Source**: [Minotaur Key](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Minotaur_Key)

A strange key that seems to fit into a rather large door. It seems to be made up of parts resembling the main three districts of Zokor.

Perhaps if a hunter journeyed through the Labyrinth, finding a large quantity of clues for each Fealty, Tech and Scholar hallways and splitting them into thirds, they might find a new entrance into a secret district within the city.

This key feels almost as if it belongs to the Labyrinth itself and not in the possession of a hunter. It seems to want to rejoin the inner workings of the maze and will only work once.

## Acquiring A Minotaur Key

Hunters must defeat the Paladin Weapon Master to obtain an Infused Plate, the Soul Binder to obtain a Sacred Script, and the Manaforge Smith to collect the Powercore Hammer. Once all three items have been obtained they can be crafted into a Minotaur Key.

Minotaur Keys are single use and Hunters must craft a new one each time they wish to enter the Lair of the Minotaur.

| Formula: Minotaur Key |  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Recipe can be unlocked by: |  |  |  |
| Item | ItemQty | ItemCost | Item Source |
| Infused Plate | 1 | N/A | Loot from Paladin Weapon Master in Zokor.<br>Use Hunter's Hammer on Minotaur Key<br>Ful'Mina's Gift<br>Ful'Mina, The Mountain Queen in Moussu Picchu<br>Rare Moussu Picchu Treasure Chests |
| Powercore Hammer | 1 | N/A | Loot from Manaforge Smith in Zokor.<br>Use Hunter's Hammer on Minotaur Key<br>Ful'Mina's Gift<br>Ful'Mina, The Mountain Queen in Moussu Picchu<br>Rare Moussu Picchu Treasure Chests |
| Sacred Script | 1 | N/A | Loot from Soul Binder in Zokor.<br>Use Hunter's Hammer on Minotaur Key<br>Ful'Mina's Gift<br>Ful'Mina, The Mountain Queen in Moussu Picchu<br>Rare Moussu Picchu Treasure Chests |
| Total | 0 |  |  |
| Recipe costs represent Shoppe prices only. The cost of items obtained through other sources will affect the total cost of crafting. |  |  |  |

The Minotaur Key can be smashed with the Hunter's Hammer to obtain the three crafting ingredients again.

## Using A Minotaur Key

To enter the Lair of the Minotaur Hunters must find a minimum of 30 Fealty, 30 Scholar, and 30 Tech clues during a single run in the Labyrinth. This will reveal a Minotaur Door once the Labyrinth has been successfully navigated. The Minotaur Door can only be opened if Hunters posses a Minotaur Key. The Minotaur Key will be consumed when the Minotaur Door is opened.

Each visit to the Lair of the Minotaur requires that Hunters craft a new Minotaur Key.

Hunters can view their stock of Minotaur Keys from the Special tab of their inventory under Equipment.

## Related Items

- Infused Plate
- Powercore Hammer
- Sacred Script

## Acquiring an Over Easy Egg Hunt

Hunters ranked Knight and above can find Over Easy Egg Hunts in Over Easy Egg Hunt Scroll Cases which can be purchased for 40 Chocolatonium at Lady Laura's Chocolate Shop. Hunters ranked Novice and above can be invited to join Over Easy Egg Hunts.

Hunters are limited to one Over Easy Egg Hunt Scroll Case in their inventory at a time.

Hunters may upgrade their Over Easy Egg Hunt to a Rare Over Easy Egg Hunt by using Rare Map Dust. This doubles the guaranteed rewards and increases the chance of receiving rare rewards.

## Redeeming an Over Easy Egg Hunt

These maps can be cashed out if they have been started but remain uncompleted at the end of the event.

The rewards for incomplete maps can only be obtained after the event ends. The Map Captain may activate Consolation Mode, allowing each participant to claim a consolation reward. The rewards include gold, points, and Ancient Charms based on how complete the map is when redeemed. If the map has been dusted, the Rare Map Dust will not be returned to the Hunter that dusted the map, even if that Hunter is no longer on the map, but the consolation items rewarded will be increased.

## Eggs found on an Over Easy Egg Hunt

Over Easy Egg Hunt require Hunters to collect 15 Eggs from around the Kingdom.

#### Guaranteed Items

These items are found in each Over Easy Treasure Chest.
