## Acquiring an Over Eggstreme Egg Hunt

Hunters ranked Viceroy and above will find Over Eggstreme Egg Hunt map in Over Eggstreme Egg Hunt Scroll Case which can be purchased for 150 Chocolatonium at Lady Laura's Chocolate Shop. Hunters ranked Grand Duke/Grand Duchess and above can be invited to join Over Eggstreme Egg Hunt.

Hunters are limited to only one Over Eggstreme Egg Hunt Scroll Case in their inventory at all times.

## Redeeming an Over Eggstreme Egg Hunt

After the event ends, a notice will read:

- These maps can be cashed out if they have been started but remain uncompleted at the end of the event.

The rewards for incomplete maps can only be obtained after the event ends. The Map Captain may activate Consolation Mode, allowing each participant to claim a consolation reward. The rewards include gold, points, and Ancient Charms based on how complete the map is when redeemed. If the map has been dusted, the Rare Map Dust will not be returned to the Hunter that dusted the map, even if that Hunter is no longer on the map, but the consolation items rewarded will be increased.

## Eggs

Each Over Eggstreme Egg Hunt require Hunters to collect 40 Eggs from around the Kingdom.

# 📦 Special Item: Gift

> **Type**: Special | **Category**: Special Items | **Source**: [Gift](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Gift)

Gifts can pertain to a number of Convertibles that are available during Events. They were originally introduced during early December 2008 to commemorate the coming Christmas day. New kinds of gifts were then introduced a couple of days before MouseHunt's 1st Birthday, then during The Great Winter Hunt '09 event, and again for MouseHunt Birthday II. The Mystery Gift Box was introduced via Gifting during the Halloween Trick AND Treat in 2010.

A hunter's gifts can be found on the Special Inventory tab.

## Birthday Gifts

The items below were released to celebrate the annual MouseHunt Birthday. They are presented in chronological order.

### Birthday Gift

These gifts were meant for MouseHunt's Birthday, but we'll let you open a few. Happy Birthday MouseHunt!

Birthday Gifts were introduced on 4 March 2009 to celebrate MouseHunt's 1st Birthday. They were dropped by Birthday mice and can only be opened from 7 March 2009 onwards. Each hunter can only receive up to 25 of these gifts.

They contain one of the following items:

- 1 Party Hat
- 2 Scrap Metal
- 5 SUPER|brie+ cheese

### Fancy Birthday Gift

These extra-special gifts were meant for the MouseHunt Developers, but you're extra-special to us. Happy Birthday MouseHunt!

Fancy Birthday Gifts were introduced on 4 March 2009 to celebrate MouseHunt's 1st Birthday. They were dropped by Birthday mice and can only be opened from 7 March 2009 onwards. Each hunter can only receive up to 1 of these gifts.

They contain one of the following items:

- 1 Birthday Cake Base
- 1 HitGrab Horsey
- 1 Polar Base

### Stolen Birthday Gift

These gifts were ordered by the King to hand out in celebration of MouseHunt's second birthday. Unfortunately the Terrible Two mice intercepted the delivery and stole all the gifts! Thanks for catching the little pest, inside is a little something to help you in your hunting...

Stolen Birthday Gifts were introduced on 7 March 2010 as part of the MouseHunt Birthday II event. They are dropped by Rockstar, Birthday, and Present mice in Town of Gnawnia.

## Great Winter Hunt Gifts

The items below were released to celebrate the annual Great Winter Hunt. They are presented in chronological order.

### Gift

In their mad dash to escape hunters, the thieving elf mice dropped a large quantity of these red gifts across the Gnawnia Mountains. The dropped gifts were quickly picked up by other mice, further spreading them across the Kingdom!

Gifts were introduced on 11 December 2008 to celebrate the Christmas season. They were dropped by Elf and Abominable Snow mice and can only be opened from 25 December 2008 onwards. Each hunter can only receive up to 30 of these gifts.

They contain one of the following items:

- 1 Coal
- 1 Hunting Research (5,000)
- 1 Polar Base
- 1 Satchel of Gold (5,000)
- 3 SUPER|brie+ cheese
- 5 Brie Alchemy Potion
- 5 Greater Brie Alchemy Potion
- 25 Brie cheese
- 50 Swiss cheese

### Magically Wrapped Gift

These gifts are specially prepared in Santa's workshop and have a magic glow about them. There is sure to be something special inside!

Magically Wrapped Gifts were introduced on 11 December 2008 to celebrate the Christmas season. They were dropped by Elf mice and can only be opened from 25 December 2008 onwards. Each hunter can only receive up to 3 of these gifts.

They contain one of the following items:

- 10 SUPER|brie+ cheese
- 20 SUPER|brie+ cheese
- 35 SUPER|brie+ cheese

These strange gifts are often handed out by people who claim that trying to open it has driven them to madness! But... It's just a small, neatly wrapped gift... how could such a pleasant looking item cause madness?

Slightly Smaller Gifts were introduced on 3 December 2009 as part of The Great Winter Hunt '09 event, and on 7 December 2010 during The Great Winter Hunt 2010 event. They could be purchased in the Festive Gift Shoppe and sent to a friend for 5,000 gold each. During the Great Winter Hunt 2013 event, they could be purchased and sent to a friend for 10,000 gold each.

Whisker Woods is a scenic hunting ground where a hunter can enjoy the peaceful atmosphere of the Calm Clearing, or choose to brave the dangerous waters of the Lagoon. The contents of this gift will no doubt prove useful no matter how you choose to spend your time in the woods!

They contain one of the following items:

- Brie Cheese
- Swiss Cheese

| Blue Winter Hunt Gift Box | Novice | Grandmaster | N/A | 2010 |

### Passing Parcel

Try your hand at tearing away a layer of this Passing Parcel. Maybe you'll get lucky and find something inside!

Passing Parcels were introduced during the Great Winter Hunt 2013 and returned for the Great Winter Hunt 2014. A parcel convertible is initially obtained by a friend purchasing a parcel via the Festive Gift Shoppe for 50,000 gold, where the recipient has to open their daily gifts to add the parcel to their Special inventory. Upon opening a convertible parcel, a hunter may obtain charms or other items to keep, or may obtain a Passing Parcel Collectible. The collectible has a message suggesting that the hunter pass the parcel along; also, during the Great Winter Hunt, a box appeared on the hunter's profile page reminding "You have X unmailed Passing Parcels!". If the hunter clicks on the link from the collectible description or the profile page, they are then taken to the Give To Friends page, where every collectible that they transfer to a friend is in turn received by the friend as a convertible, thus continuing the cycle.

Each parcel contains one of the following items:

- 1-5 Extreme Luck Charm
- 1-5 Festive Feta cheese
- 5-15 Gingerbread Cheese
- 75-125 Luck Charm
- 40-60 Lucky Power Charm
- 1 Pair of Tickets
- 1 Passing Parcel
- 150-250 Power Charm
- 5-10 Seasoned Gouda cheese
- 80-100 Shortbread Cookie
- 30-40 Super Luck Charm
- 30-55 Super Power Charm
- 1-5 Winter Charm

# 📦 Special Item: Prolific Printing Paper

> **Type**: Special | **Category**: Special Items | **Source**: [Prolific Printing Paper](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Prolific_Printing_Paper)

Each roll of this truly extraordinary paper is handcrafted by the talented artisans that work in the General Stores throughout the Folklore Forest. It is infused with a unique, magical blend of inspiration, creativity, and artistic genius. Any words printed onto these rolls are instantly imbued with such prolific gravitas that it will blow the mind of any mouse who dares to read it!

The Folklore Printing Press Base and Naughty List Printing Press Base will consume one of these rolls per hunt in any Folklore Forest location in order to boost its stats tremendously!

## Source

Prolific Printing Paper can be purchased from all General Stores in the Folklore Forest region. Each store has a different price which requires that location's currency.

- Foreword Farm General Store
40,000 gold
180 Crop Coin
- Prologue Pond General Store
40,000 gold
300 Pond Penny
- Table of Contents General Store
40,000 gold
80 Gnawbel Prize for Literature
- Bountiful Beanstalk General Store
40,000 gold
512 Golden Goose Egg
- School of Sorcery General Store
40,000 gold
80 Sorcerer's Sapphire
- Draconic Depths General Store
40,000 gold
160 Dragon's Breath Opal
- Afterword Acres General Store
40,000 gold
2 Idea Germ
- Epilogue Falls General Store
40,000 gold
5 Pearl of Wisdom

## Usage

When the Hunter has at least 1 Prolific Printing Paper in their inventory, the Naughty List Printing Press Base's and Folklore Printing Press Base's stats within Folklore Forest region are boosted to:

- 4,500 Power
- 35% Power Bonus
- 35% Attraction Bonus
- 57 Luck

1 Prolific Printing Paper is consumed per hunt for boosting the Base's stats.

These are special items that are used to progress in Cerulean Skyport.
They can be accessed from the Heads-Up Display in those locations.

## Dirigible Debris

This may look like a worthless hunk of wood and cloth nailed together but despite appearances, this is a valuable and highly sought-after resource at the Cerulean Skyport due to its wide range of industrial uses. These are made from the bits and pieces of dirigibles that came in a little too quickly when attempting to dock.

The scavenging scoundrels known as the Debris Raiders scour the Skydocks to collect this covetous commodity before it can be traded legally.

### Source

- Mouse loot
Cerulean Skyport while docked

### Usage

- Trading with Debris Traders in Cerulean Skyport

### Links

- Image
- Larry's Lexicon

## Atmospherium Gas

Compressed within this canister is an artisanal blend of the finest free-range atmospheric gases, hand-harvested from certified organic air farms. This highly valuable and desperately sought-after resource has a wide range of practical uses amongst the empyrean elite such as: breathing.

### Source

- Mouse loot
Cerulean Skyport while Cerulean Skyport#Trading with Atmp Trader

### Usage

- Trading with Atmo Traders in Cerulean Skyport

### Links

- Image
- Larry's Lexicon

## Unrefined Cloudstone

This aerial ore is an extremely valuable commodity to the citizens of the sky, even in its unrefined state. It has a wide range of practical uses and an even wider range of impractical, purely aesthetic uses. One of its most common uses is for popular jewelry such as the Cloudstone Bangles that the Sky Paragons of the Floating Islands are known to be fond of.

### Source

- Mouse loot
Cerulean Skyport while Cerulean Skyport#Trading with Mining Trader

### Usage

- Trading with Spice Traders in Cerulean Skyport

### Links

- Image
- Larry's Lexicon

## Aurora Spice

Some people believe that the beautiful auroras that fill the night sky in certain parts of the world are a visual phenomenon caused by charged particles from the sun colliding with oxygen and nitrogen atoms in the atmosphere, exciting them, and causing them to emit light in colourful, dynamic patterns.

Those people are grossly misinformed. Auroras are actually vast fields of colourful, magical spice floating gracefully through the sky. What few ground dwellers know is that the Aurora Spice is just as flavourful as it is beautiful so there is an entire airborne industry that revolves around harvesting this magical spice for a variety of culinary uses.

The most famous, or perhaps infamous, use for Aurora Spice is in the production of Aurora Bocconcini Cheese which is a delicacy for the Sky Commander mice who frequent the Cerulean Skyport.

### Source

- Mouse loot
Cerulean Skyport while Cerulean Skyport#Trading with Spice Trader

### Usage

- Purchasing Aurora Bocconcini Cheese in Cerulean Skyport's Cheese Shoppe

### Links

- Image
- Larry's Lexicon

## Cerulean Chrome Ingot

This extraordinarily valuable, mesmerizingly shiny, and inexplicably buoyant metal ingot is the single most sought-after resource across all layers of the Gnawnian atmosphere. Its tantalizing shimmer and exceptionally powerful magical properties are enough to make even the most honest mice turn to a life of crime and greed.

The Sky Raiders have been stealing these ingots for ages and delivering them to their leader, Captain Crook. As the supreme commander of all airborne villainy, Captain Crook hoards these ingots to herself and so far the only person that has ever managed to steal some back is the fearless and intrepid Ronza.

If honest and noble MouseHunters were able to retrieve these valuable, stolen goods from the Captain then, in the right hands, they could possibly be used to create unimaginable new technologies for the purposes of good.

### Source

- Mouse loot
Captain Crook

### Usage

- Purchasing items in Cerulean Skyport's Shops

### Links

- Image
- Larry's Lexicon

## RaidBuster™ Cannonball

Are your shipments constantly being threatened by airborne pirates? Is your Kingdom being bombarded by a relentless fleet of mobile marauders? Have Sky Raiders got you down?! If you answered yes to any of these questions then you're in need of this exciting new product: RaidBuster™ Cannonballs (patent pending)!

Simply load these sleek, shiny, and meticulously handcrafted cannonballs into your cannon and fire away as you hunt! Each RaidBuster™ Cannonball is made from a little bit of every known metal ore in existence which makes them impervious to any and all Sky Raider defences. Every time you hit a Sky Raider with one of these state-of-the-art cannonballs, they are guaranteed to drop a little bit more of whatever they were trying to steal!

Take back the skies today with RaidBuster™ Cannonballs!

Fire RaidBuster™ Cannonballs while hunting in the Cerulean Skyport to add +1 to loot drops of Corsair's Curds, Dirigible Debris, Atmospherium Gas, Unrefined Cloudstone, Aurora Spice, Raid Intel, and Cerulean Chrome Ingots.

### Source

- Mouse loot

### Usage

- Purchasing items in Cerulean Skyport's Shops

### Links

- Image
- Larry's Lexicon

# 📦 Special Item: Rain Warden Stone

> **Type**: Special | **Category**: Special Items | **Source**: [Rain Warden Stone](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Rain_Warden_Stone)

This strangely mesmerizing stone glistens with a layer of moisture that never seems to dry. It is difficult to handle but not merely because of its slippery surface. It seems to be drawn to something far away as though it had been wrongfully removed and is forever trying to return.

Ful'Mina and her Storm Dragons guard these stones very carefully. The locals believe that the only way to retrieve one is by carrying a fully functional Skyfarer's Oculus while hunting.

## Acquiring A Rain Warden Stone

Hunters must first craft a Skyfarer's Oculus by repairing a Damaged Oculus dropped by Ful'Mina, The Mountain Queen. Afterwhich, all Storm Dragons will have a chance of dropping a Rain Warden Stone, along with the Wind Warden Stone, Fog Warden Stone and Frost Warden Stone.

## Usage

- Purchase the Dirigible and Flight License at the Moussu Picchu Cartographer together with the Skyfarer's Oculus, Wind Warden Stone, Fog Warden Stone and Frost Warden Stone for 2,500,000 Gold.

# 📦 Special Item: Rare Map Dust

> **Type**: Special | **Category**: Special Items | **Source**: [Rare Map Dust](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Rare_Map_Dust)

## Description

Scraped carefully from an old, rare map, this dust can instantly transform a Common Treasure Map into a Rare Treasure Map, increasing the rewards gained for everyone working on solving it! The difficulty of the map doesn't increase, only the delicious loot!

Rare Map Dust leads to Rare Treasure Chests containing:

## Obtained Via

Rare Map Dust can be obtained rarely from opening any Scroll Case except Sealed Wanted Poster. The Rare Map Dust can be found under the Special tab of the inventory.

When the Rare Map Dust is obtained, a message appears:

## Usage

To use a Rare Map Dust, click on the Treasure Map currently being followed and click Upgrade. This upgrade is applied to all players following the map, not just the player that does the upgrade. Once the dust has been applied, the map changes from a Common map to a Rare map. The list of mice to be captured remains the same. The only difference is that, upon completion of the map, the Treasure Chest awarded will be a Rare treasure chest instead of a normal one. The following message is placed in the Hunter's Journal of the hunter that performs the upgrade:

or when used on a Wanted Poster:

At the King's Arms or King's Cart:

- 1 Rare Map Dust can be used to upgrade a Rainbow Scroll Case into a Party Size Rainbow Scroll Case (together with 50 Magic Essence)
- 2 Rare Map Dust can be used to upgrade a Slayer Scroll Case into a Chrome Slayer Scroll Case (together with 100 Ancient Relics)

## Acquiring a Rift Halloween Treasure Map

These maps were only available from Sealed Rift Halloween Scroll Cases during the Halloween 2015 event.

The Sealed Rift Halloween Scroll Case can be purchased at the Haunted Terrortories Cartographer in exchange for 2 Ancient Relics.

Hunters are limited to two Sealed Rift Halloween Scroll Cases in their inventory at a time.

## Redeeming a Rift Halloween Treasure Map

These maps can be cashed out if they have been started but remain uncompleted at the end of the event.

The rewards for incomplete maps can only be obtained after the event ends. The Map Captain may activate Consolation Mode, allowing each participant to claim a consolation reward. The rewards include gold, points, and Ancient Charms based on how complete the map is when redeemed. If the map has been dusted, the Rare Map Dust will not be returned to the Hunter that dusted the map, even if that Hunter is no longer on the map, but the consolation items rewarded will be increased.

## Mice found on a Rift Halloween Treasure Map

These maps contained 20 mice found in the Haunted Terrortories 2015. Many mice require Extra Spooky Charms to attract and a Rift weapon is recommended to catch them. Hunters under the rank of Count or Countess will have difficulty completing these maps with out help from Hunters ranked Count or Countess and above.

## Acquiring a Valentine's Treasure Map

This map is only found in Valentine's Scroll Cases. Hunters may only have two Valentine's Scroll Cases in their inventory at a time.

- 2017: The maps found in Valentine's Scroll Cases were changed to contain only the 8 Valentine's Mice.

- 2015: Valentine's Scroll Cases were dropped by Valentine's Mice during the Valentine's 2015 weekend event.

## Mice found on a Valentine's Treasure Map

These maps contain 8 mice found throughout many parts of the Kingdom.

Valentine's Mice were able to be found in the following locations:

- Town of Gnawnia
- Harbour
- Great Gnarled Tree
- Town of Digby
- Bazaar
- Training Grounds
- Cape Clawed
- Slushy Shoreline
- Muridae Market
- Sunken City - See the note below for zone restrictions
- Gnawnia Rift
- Fungal Cavern

Note: Although Valentine's Mice have been able to brace the underwater currents outside the Sunken City, they're not quite talented enough swimmers to reach all underwater zones. Hunters won't encounter any Valentine's Mice within the following zones: Sand Dollar Sea Bar, Feeding Grounds, Pearl Patch, Carnivore Cove, Sunken Treasure, Monster Trench, Oxygen Stream, Magma Flow, and Lair of the Ancients.

# 📦 Special Item: S.L.A.C. in a Box

> **Type**: Special | **Category**: Special Items | **Source**: [S.L.A.C. in a Box](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/S.L.A.C._in_a_Box)

This remarkable contraption automatically plugs directly into any S.L.A.C. or S.L.A.C. II trap and increases its power bonus and luck with every crank of its arm. But once it goes POP, so do all of those lovely bonuses!

Using the S.L.A.C. or S.L.A.C. II while this item is in your inventory will increase your S.L.A.C.'s Power Bonus by 2% and Luck by 2 with every mouse catch until it pops!

## Source

The S.L.A.C. in a Box could be bought from the General Store in Festive Comet during Great Winter Hunt 2020 for:

- 30,000 gold
- 40 Nutcracker Sugar Cookie
- 10 Ornament Sugar Cookie
- 10 Snowflake Sugar Cookie

It cannot be refunded.

## Usage

Having a S.L.A.C. in a Box in the inventory will enable a special stats bonus to S.L.A.C. or S.L.A.C. II:

- The bonus starts at 0.
- Each catch using the those weapons will increase the Power Bonus by 2% and Luck by 2.
- At the bonus of 40% Power Bonus and 40 Luck, the next catch using those weapons will reset the bonus to 0.

Each time the bonus increases, it generates a journal entry:

| Catch # | Power Bonus | Luck | Message |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 2% | 2 | All |
| 2 | 4% | 4 | around |
| 3 | 6% | 6 | the |
| 4 | 8% | 8 | big scary |
| 5 | 10% | 10 | trap, |
| 6 | 12% | 12 | the mousey |
| 7 | 14% | 14 | chased |
| 8 | 16% | 16 | the |
| 9 | 18% | 18 | cheese wheel. |
| 10 | 20% | 20 | The mousey |
| 11 | 22% | 22 | thought |
| 12 | 24% | 24 | it was |
| 13 | 26% | 26 | all in |
| 14 | 28% | 28 | good |
| 15 | 30% | 30 | fun... |
| 16 | 32% | 32 | SNAP |
| 17 | 34% | 34 | goes |
| 18 | 36% | 36 | the |
| 19 | 38% | 38 | trap |
| 20 | 40% | 40 | SQUEAL! |

## Related Items

- S.L.A.C.
- S.L.A.C. II

# 📦 Special Item: Scroll Case

> **Type**: Special | **Category**: Special Items | **Source**: [Scroll Case](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Scroll_Case)

## Overview

Scroll Case is a type of Special items.

These items are shown under Special inventory tab, Adventuring Items sub-tab.

Each Scroll Case contain 1 Treasure Map. For Scroll Case with multiple possible maps, the conditions to get each map are available in the individual map pages.

Opening a Scroll Case has a chance to produce 1 Rare Map Dust.

### Scroll Case types

The Scroll Cases can be divided to 3 types, corresponding to 3 types of Treasure Maps:

- Non-event Scroll Cases contain maps that require catching non-event mice.
- Event Scroll Cases contain maps that require catching event mice.
- Sealed Wanted Poster contains Wanted Posters.

## Non-event Scroll Cases

### Area-Specific Scroll Cases

These Scroll Cases can be purchased from Cartographer for Ancient Relic. Each contains a map that focus on a few specific mouse group.

| Scroll Case | Description | Cartographer | Cost | Treasure Map | Image link |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Acolyte Scroll Case | An ancient scroll case containing a map to treasures hidden primarily within the Catacombs, Forbidden Grove, and Acolyte Realm. | Catacombs | 3 Ancient Relic | Acolyte Treasure Map | Image |
| Bountiful Beanstalk Scroll Case | This scroll case was fashioned from a vine that was trimmed from the Bountiful Beanstalk and then bejewelled with the many precious beans from the Castle in the Clouds. | Bountiful Beanstalk | 10 Ancient Relic20 Fabled Fertilizer | Bountiful Beanstalk Treasure Map | Image |

## Event Scroll Cases

### Event Scroll Cases — Redeemable Maps

These Scroll Cases are often found at the Event Cartographers.

Maps in these scroll cases (found after the Season 3 map update of 23 June 2015) can be cashed out if they are started and remain unfinished after the end of an event.

The rewards for incomplete maps can only be obtained after the event ends. The Map Captain may activate Consolation Mode, allowing each participant to claim a consolation reward. The rewards include gold, points, and Ancient Charms based on how complete the map is when redeemed. If the map has been dusted, the Rare Map Dust will not be returned to the Hunter that dusted the map, even if that Hunter is no longer on the map, but the consolation items rewarded will be increased.

# 📦 Special Item: Sky Glass

> **Type**: Special | **Category**: Special Items | **Source**: [Sky Glass](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Sky_Glass)

This precious crystalline stone occurs naturally in island rock formations but can only be extracted with expensive and time-consuming mining techniques. Its immense strength and natural transparency make it an extremely useful material in the construction of many advanced gadgets. It was named for its uncanny resemblance to glass as well as its remarkable magnification properties.

## Source

Loot obtained in the Floating Islands Tower. It drops on both Low Altitude Islands and High Altitude Islands. The quantity in which it drops is influenced by the buffs present and active on the island.

## Usage

- Used to purchase Extra Rich Cloud Cheesecake and 2-Pack of Extra Rich Cloud Cheesecake in Floating Islands Cheese Shoppe
- Used to purchase Adorned Empyrean Jewel and Adorned Empyrean Refractor Base in Floating Islands Trapsmith.
- Used to purchase Dragonbane Charm in the Floating Islands Charm Shoppe
- Used to purchase Bottled Wind, Cyclone Stone and the Glistening Galleon Airship Set in the Floating Islands General Store
- Used to upgrade the Oculus in the Floating Islands

## Links

- Image
- Larry's Lexicon

# 📦 Special Item: Sky Ore

> **Type**: Special | **Category**: Special Items | **Source**: [Sky Ore](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Sky_Ore)

This highly valuable substance is formed when common minerals are subjected to the unique pressures caused by tectonic shifts at high altitudes. It's sun-kissed orange hue comes from absorbing an immeasurable number of sunsets.

## Source

Loot obtained in the Floating Islands Tower. It drops on both Low Altitude Islands and High Altitude Islands. The quantity in which it drops is influenced by the buffs present and active on the island.

# 📦 Special Item: Skyfarer's Oculus

> **Type**: Special | **Category**: Special Items | **Source**: [Skyfarer's Oculus](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Skyfarer's_Oculus)

A brilliantly ornate, gold-ringed ocular lens. This mechanism uses unique crystals to focus and channel light rays through melted prisms to provide unparalleled image clarity. With this miraculous device, you will be able to see farther than ever thought possible by land-dwellers. Gazing upon it you cannot help but ponder, what spectacular wonders will this oculus behold?

Carrying such a magically charged item will help hunters to attract some of the Storm Dragons' most cherished possessions: the uniquely powerful Warden Stones.

## Acquiring A Skyfarer's Oculus

Hunters must defeat Ful'Mina, The Mountain Queen to obtain a Damaged Oculus. The Damaged Oculus has to be combined with items which can drop from Storm Dragons and other sources.

Upon acquiring the Skyfarer's Oculus, the Wind Warden Stone, Fog Warden Stone, Frost Warden Stone and Rain Warden Stone will start dropping from Storm Dragons, which are used together with the Skyfarer's Oculus to purchase the Dirigible and Flight License which grants access to the Floating Islands.

# 📦 Special Item: Snowball Mystery Pack

> **Type**: Special | **Category**: Special Items | **Source**: [Snowball Mystery Pack](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Snowball_Mystery_Pack)

A chilly package of Snowball Charms! There could be one, there could be five OR there could be any number in between! It's amazing how they keep cold in the packaging! What will they think of next?!

# 📦 Special Item: Spooky Shuffle

> **Type**: Special | **Category**: Special Items | **Source**: [Spooky Shuffle](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Spooky_Shuffle)

The Spooky Shuffle is a mini-game present in the Heads-up Display of the Halloween event location. It is a memory-style matching game, with 18 cards containing 9 pairs of Halloween items. The cards are randomly shuffled to a different location for each hunter, although once the shuffle occurs for all cards face-down, individual cards do not move location until a hunter completes the game. On the bottom of the game are the rules:

Failing to make a match will use one Spooky Shuffle Ticket.

On the top right is a count of the user's current inventory of Spooky Shuffle Ticket. On the top left is a message giving current status; depending on what has been clicked, it will be one of:

Each match made also leaves a message in the Hunter's Journal:

Making all 9 matches awards a hunter with an additional bonus of 10 SUPER|brie+ (100 if completing an upgraded board) with the following popup message:

It then resets the board to a fresh shuffle and leaves of the following two messages (depending on whether the board was upgraded) in the Hunter's Journal:

The Hunter can choose to do a Regular Board or Upgraded Board. Choosing upgraded board consumes 1 Spooky Shuffle Dust.

Each board has 9 rewards, in which 4 are guaranteed to appear and 5 are randomly chosen from a list of variable rewards. The rewards are tied to the Hunter's rank.

Completing a board grands the completion reward.

# 📦 Special Item: Spooky Surprise

> **Type**: Special | **Category**: Special Items | **Source**: [Spooky Surprise](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Spooky_Surprise)

The various sweets and goodies in this box are the stolen haul of the mischievous mice that were running amok in the Haunted Terrortories.To open this box, visit the special section of your inventory.

In Halloween at the Haunted Terrortories (2011), a Spooky Surprise was the reward for finding all 10 mischievous pranksters hidden in the Haunted Terrortories by your Hunting Team. Once your team has caught the 10 pranksters, visit your Gifts page to claim Spooky Surprise from the King, then open it on the special section of the inventory.

In Halloween 2012, a Spooky Surprise was found inside a Halloween Treasure Chest (whether rare or common) at the conclusion of a Halloween Treasure Map.

In Halloween 2013, both Halloween Treasure Chests and Undead Halloween Treasure Chests included a Spooky Surprise, and it was also possible to gain a Spooky Surprise by competing in a Zombie SUPER|hunt+ Tournament.

## Contents

- 1 of the following
20 Candy Corn Cheese
20 Ghoulgonzola Cheese
10 Candy Corn Cheese and 10 Ghoulgonzola Cheese
- 10-20 Spooky Charms
- 8-12 Halloween Candies
- 1 of the following
1 King's Credit
1 Cobweb

# 📦 Special Item: Tome of Wisdom

> **Type**: Special | **Category**: Special Items | **Source**: [Tome of Wisdom](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Tome_of_Wisdom)

This magical tome contains hunting knowledge. Opening the tome bestows this wisdom upon the hunter, furthering their hunter's title and giving bonus points.

A colored Tome of Wisdom is awarded to a hunter upon completion of a Library Assignment. The Silver Tome of Wisdom is a rare reward in Relic Hunter Treasure Chests.

Each tome appears in the hunter's Special Inventory, where it can be opened with the Read button. The color of a tome is determined by the relative difficulty of the assignment that awarded it, and the amount of Points earned upon reading a tome are as follows:

| Color | Points | Image | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Yellow Tome of Wisdom | 45,000 | Image | Catalog Library AssignmentLibrary Mice AssignmentLibrary Power Type AssignmentCatalog Haunted Mice |
| Green Tome of Wisdom | 90,000 | Image | Library Mice AssignmentLibrary Power Type AssignmentAcrostic Research AssignmentCatalog Haunted Mice |
| Blue Tome of Wisdom | 130,000 | Image | Seasonal Garden AssignmentMystic King AssignmentTechnic King AssignmentZurreal Trap Research AssignmentAcrostic Research AssignmentAdvanced Terrortories Research |
| Purple Tome of Wisdom | 180,000 | Image | Furoma AssignmentPagoda AssignmentDojo Sensei AssignmentMystic Amplifier AssignmentTechnic Amplifier AssignmentAdvanced Amplifier AssignmentM400 Bait Research Assignment |
| Red Tome of Wisdom | 270,000 | Image | M400 Bait Research Assignment |
| Silver Tome of Wisdom | 520,000 | Image | M400 Hunting Research AssignmentRelic Hunter Treasure Chests |

An unreleased Onyx Tome of Wisdom is also mentioned in Larry's Loot Lexicon, but until a library assignment can actually award this tome, its point value is unknown.

All tomes initially had an inventory limit of 3 per color. Any tomes earned while the Hunter's inventory was full would be lost. That restriction is no longer in place.

Warpath Portal Projectors are single use and Hunters must purchase a new one each time they wish to enter the Artillery Commander's Tent.
After entering the Artillery Commander's Tent the following message is displayed in the hunters' journal:

A Ruined Portal Projector is rewarded each time you use a Warpath Portal Projector.
Hunters can view their stock of Ruined Portal Projectors from the Inventory tab of their inventory under Collectibles.

# 📦 Special Item: Wind Warden Stone

> **Type**: Special | **Category**: Special Items | **Source**: [Wind Warden Stone](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Wind_Warden_Stone)

An ominous breeze perpetually circles this tiny, ancient stone. While its origin is unknown, it clearly comes from a place unlike anywhere you have ever been. A place that must be more powerful than you can possibly imagine.

Ful'Mina and her Storm Dragons guard these stones very carefully. The locals believe that the only way to retrieve one is by carrying a fully functional Skyfarer's Oculus while hunting.

## Acquiring A Wind Warden Stone

Hunters must first craft a Skyfarer's Oculus by repairing a Damaged Oculus dropped by Ful'Mina, The Mountain Queen. Afterwhich, all Storm Dragons will have a chance of dropping a Wind Warden Stone, along with the Rain Warden Stone, Fog Warden Stone and Frost Warden Stone.

## Usage

- Purchase the Dirigible and Flight License at the Moussu Picchu Cartographer together with the Skyfarer's Oculus, Rain Warden Stone, Fog Warden Stone and Frost Warden Stone for 2,500,000 Gold.

## Related Items

> **Type**: Auras | **Category**: Auras | **Source**: [Anniversary Aura](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Anniversary_Aura)

## Overview

The Anniversary Aura is an Aura that can be earned by either opening a MouseHunt Birthday-related Treasure Chest or fulfilling a specific task during the annual MouseHunt Birthday event.

It is represented by a birthday cake in the upper left of the main trap image on the Camp page.

## Aura Effects

- Adds SUPER|brie+ to mouse loot pool
- Adds Party Charm to mouse loot pool

## Source

The Hunter must open a MouseHunt Birthday-related Treasure Chest or fulfill a specific task during the annual MouseHunt Birthday event to obtain the Anniversary Aura.

The Anniversary Aura's duration time stacks, so the Aura's time will be extended each time the Hunter opens an additional MouseHunt Birthday-related Treasure Chest or fulfills an Aura-awarding task.

The Aura cannot be extended beyond the next MouseHunt's Birthday, which is 7 March. This limit is updated at the beginning of each MouseHunt Birthday event.

# 🌟 Aura: Spooky Aura

> **Type**: Auras | **Category**: Auras | **Source**: [Spooky Aura](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Spooky_Aura)

## Overview

The Spooky Aura is an Aura that can be earned during the annual Halloween event.

The Aura duration time stacks, so it would be extended each time the Hunter is granted the Aura.

It is represented by a green skull icon in the upper left of the main trap image on the Camp page.

## Aura Effects

- Grants 30% Power Bonus
- Adds Wealth Charm, Super Wealth Charm, Extreme Wealth Charm, and Ultimate Wealth Charm to mouse loot pool
- Adds a chance to double the gold dropped by most mice (additional gold is looted as Cursed Gold)
Mice attracted by Polter-Geitost in the Gloomy Greenwood will only drop 50% of their gold value as Cursed Gold

## Source

### Halloween 2021 onward

The Hunter could earn the Spooky Aura by crushing Cursed Skull earned during the annual Halloween event.
The Spooky Aura's duration time stacks, so the Aura's time would be extended each time the Hunter smashes an additional Skull.

The Skulls no longer have an expiry date.

### Halloween 2020

The Hunter could earn the Spooky Aura by crushing Cursed Skull.
The Spooky Aura's duration time stacks, so the Aura's time would be extended each time the Hunter smashes an additional Skull.

After 3 November 2020, all remaining Skulls automatically crumbled and rewarded the Aura upon the Hunter's first hunt after that day. On 1 December 2020, all Skulls not crumbled yet (by not hunting) were removed from inventory without rewarding the Aura.

### 2019: Spooky Schnooner's Revenge

The Hunter could earn the Spooky Aura by destroying the Grand Ghostship and then claiming the reward upon reaching certain milestones.

- 200 Spooky Ship Parts: 7 days
- 1,000 Spooky Ship Parts: 7 days
- 2,000 Spooky Ship Parts: 14 days

The Spooky Aura's duration time stacks, so the Aura's time will be extended each time the Hunter claims an additional aura reward.

### 2018: Admiral Arrgh's Revenge

The Hunter could earn the Spooky Aura by destroying ghostships. The Aura duration gained depends on the type of ghostship.

- The Gnawnian Ghoul: 15 hours
- The Boney Barge: 16 hours
- Martial Mayhem: 18 hours
- The Soul of the Sea: 20 hours
- The Demon of the Desert: 22 hours
- The Queasy Queso Cruiser: 23 hours
- The Ancient Apparition: 24 hours
- The Phantom of the Plane: 30 hours

The Spooky Aura's duration time stacks, so the Aura's time will be extended each time the Hunter destroys an additional ghostship.

The Aura could not be extended beyond 1 December 2018.

### 2017: Creepy Carl's Cursed Cruise

The Hunter could earn the Spooky Aura by destroying ghostships. The Aura duration gained depends on the type of ghostship.

- The Gnawnian Ghoul: 15 hours
- Martial Mayhem: 18 hours
- The Soul of the Sea: 20 hours
- The Demon of the Desert: 22 hours
- The Ancient Apparition: 24 hours
- The Phantom of the Plane: 30 hours

The Spooky Aura's duration time stacks, so the Aura's time will be extended each time the Hunter destroys an additional ghostship.

The Aura could not be extended beyond 30 November 2017.

# 🌟 Aura: Sugar Rush Aura

> **Type**: Auras | **Category**: Auras | **Source**: [Sugar Rush Aura](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Sugar_Rush_Aura)

The Sugar Rush Aura is a trap bonus that can be earned during the annual Halloween event. It is represented by a wrapped candy image in the upper left of the main trap image on the Camp page.

## 2016

Hunters are awarded the Sugar Rush Aura upon opening a Magical Pillowcase.

It provides a 10% Power Bonus to the Hunter's trap throughout the Kingdom. It also boosts the effects of the Candy Charm.

While active, mice throughout the Kingdom may drop Spooky Shuffle Tickets and Candy Charms as loot.

Each Magical Pillowcase opened will reward 48 hours of the Sugar Rush Aura. The aura's duration time stacks and the aura's time will be extended each time Hunters open an additional Magical Pillowcase.

## Image

- Sugar Rush Aura

# 🌟 Aura: Winter Aura

> **Type**: Auras | **Category**: Auras | **Source**: [Winter Aura](https://mhwiki.hitgrab.com/wiki/index.php/Winter_Aura)

## Overview

The Winter Aura is an Aura that can be earned during the annual Great Winter Hunt.

It is represented by a snowflake image in the upper left of the main trap image on the Camp page.

## Winter Aura Effects

- Grants 5 bonus Luck
- Adds Festive loot to mouse loot pool:
Festive Ultimate Luck Charm
Festive Ultimate Power Charm
Snowball Charm
SUPER|brie+
Winter Hunt Gift Box

## Obtaining Winter Aura

### 2024

The Hunter can earn the Winter Aura by claiming Snow Golem rewards. The Aura duration gained depends on whether the Golem wears a Magical Holiday Hat or not:

- Normal Golem: 5 hours
- Golem with a Magical Holiday Hat: 10 hours

The Winter Aura's duration time stacks, so the Aura's time will be extended each time the Hunter claims an additional Golem.

The Aura cannot be extended beyond 20 March 2025.
